1939.text: When Pharʹaoh’s horses with his war chariots and his cavalrymen went into the sea, Then Jehovah brought back the waters of the sea upon them, While the sons of Israel walked on dry land through the midst of the sea.”

1940.label: Exodus 15:20
1940.text: And Mirʹi·am the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, proceeded to take a tambourine in her hand; and all the women began going out with her with tambourines and in dances.

1941.label: Exodus 15:21
1941.text: And Mirʹi·am kept responding to the men: “Sing to Jehovah, for he has become highly exalted. The horse and its rider he has pitched into the sea.”

1942.label: Exodus 15:22
1942.text: Later Moses caused Israel to depart from the Red Sea and they went out to the wilderness of Shur and marched on for three days in the wilderness, but they did not find water.

1943.label: Exodus 15:23
1943.text: In time they came to Maʹrah, but they were not able to drink the water from Maʹrah because it was bitter. That is why he called its name Maʹrah.

1944.label: Exodus 15:24
1944.text: And the people began to murmur against Moses, saying: “What are we to drink?”

1945.label: Exodus 15:25
1945.text: Then he cried out to Jehovah. So Jehovah directed him to a tree, and he threw it into the water and the water became sweet. There He established for them a regulation and a case for judgment and there he put them to the test.

1946.label: Exodus 15:26
1946.text: And he went on to say: “If you will strictly listen to the voice of Jehovah your God and will do what is right in his eyes and will indeed give ear to his commandments and keep all his regulations, I shall put none of the maladies upon you that I put upon the Egyptians; because I am Jehovah who is healing you.”

1947.label: Exodus 15:27
1947.text: After that they came to Eʹlim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. So they went camping there by the water.

1948.label: Exodus 16:1
1948.text: Later they departed from Eʹlim, and the entire assembly of the sons of Israel finally came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Eʹlim and Siʹnai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their coming out of the land of Egypt.

1949.label: Exodus 16:2
1949.text: And the entire assembly of the sons of Israel began to murmur against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.

1950.label: Exodus 16:3
1950.text: And the sons of Israel kept saying to them: “If only we had died by Jehovah’s hand in the land of Egypt while we were sitting by the pots of meat, while we were eating bread to satisfaction, because YOU have brought us out into this wilderness to put this whole congregation to death by famine.”

1951.label: Exodus 16:4
1951.text: Then Jehovah said to Moses: “Here I am raining down bread for YOU from the heavens; and the people must go out and pick up each his amount day for day, in order that I may put them to the test as to whether they will walk in my law or not.

1952.label: Exodus 16:5
1952.text: And it must occur on the sixth day that they must prepare what they will bring in, and it must prove double what they keep picking up day by day.”

1953.label: Exodus 16:6
1953.text: So Moses and Aaron said to all the sons of Israel: “At evening YOU will certainly know that it is Jehovah who has brought YOU out from the land of Egypt.

1954.label: Exodus 16:7
1954.text: And in the morning YOU will indeed see Jehovah’s glory, because he has heard YOUR murmurings against Jehovah. And what are we that YOU should murmur against us?”

1955.label: Exodus 16:8
1955.text: And Moses continued: “It will be when Jehovah gives YOU in the evening meat to eat and in the morning bread to satisfaction, because Jehovah has heard YOUR murmurings that YOU are murmuring against him. And what are we? YOUR murmurings are not against us, but against Jehovah.”

1956.label: Exodus 16:9
1956.text: And Moses went on to say to Aaron: “Say to the entire assembly of the sons of Israel, ‘Come near before Jehovah, because he has heard YOUR murmurings.’”

1957.label: Exodus 16:10
1957.text: Then it occurred that as soon as Aaron had spoken to the entire assembly of the sons of Israel, they turned and faced toward the wilderness, and, look! Jehovah’s glory appeared in the cloud.

1958.label: Exodus 16:11
1958.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

1959.label: Exodus 16:12
1959.text: “I have heard the murmurings of the sons of Israel. Speak to them, saying, ‘Between the two evenings YOU will eat meat and in the morning YOU will be satisfied with bread; and YOU will certainly know that I am Jehovah YOUR God.’”

1960.label: Exodus 16:13
1960.text: Accordingly it occurred that in the evening the quails began to come up and cover the camp, and in the morning there had developed a layer of dew round about the camp.

1961.label: Exodus 16:14
1961.text: In time the layer of dew evaporated and here upon the surface of the wilderness there was a fine flaky thing, fine like hoarfrost upon the earth.

1962.label: Exodus 16:15
1962.text: When the sons of Israel got to see it, they began to say to one another: “What is it?” For they did not know what it was. Hence Moses said to them: “It is the bread that Jehovah has given YOU for food.

1963.label: Exodus 16:16
1963.text: This is the word that Jehovah has commanded, ‘Pick up some of it, each one in proportion to his eating. YOU are to take an omer measure for each individual according to the number of the souls that each of YOU has in his tent.’”

1964.label: Exodus 16:17
1964.text: And the sons of Israel began to do so; and they went picking it up, some gathering much and some gathering little.

1965.label: Exodus 16:18
1965.text: When they would measure it by the omer, he that had gathered much had no surplus and he that had gathered little had no shortage. They picked it up each one in proportion to his eating.

1966.label: Exodus 16:19
1966.text: Then Moses said to them: “Let nobody leave any of it until the morning.”

1967.label: Exodus 16:20
1967.text: But they did not listen to Moses. When some men would leave some of it until the morning, it would breed worms and stink; so that Moses became indignant at them.

1968.label: Exodus 16:21
1968.text: And they would pick it up morning by morning, each one in proportion to his eating. When the sun got hot, it melted.

1969.label: Exodus 16:22
1969.text: And it came about on the sixth day that they picked up twice as much bread, two omer measures for one person. So all the chieftains of the assembly came and reported it to Moses.

1970.label: Exodus 16:23
1970.text: At that he said to them: “It is what Jehovah has spoken. Tomorrow there will be a sabbath observance of a holy sabbath to Jehovah. What YOU can bake, bake, and what YOU can boil, boil, and all the surplus that there is save it up for YOU as something to be kept until the morning.”

1971.label: Exodus 16:24
1971.text: Accordingly they saved it up until the morning, just as Moses had commanded; and it did not stink nor did maggots develop in it.

1972.label: Exodus 16:25
1972.text: Then Moses said: “Eat it today, because today is a sabbath to Jehovah. Today YOU will not find it in the field.

1973.label: Exodus 16:26
1973.text: Six days YOU will pick it up, but on the seventh day is a sabbath. On it none will form.”

1974.label: Exodus 16:27
1974.text: However, it came about on the seventh day that some of the people did go out to pick [it] up, but they found none.

1975.label: Exodus 16:28
1975.text: Consequently Jehovah said to Moses: “How long must YOU people refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?

1976.label: Exodus 16:29
1976.text: Mark the fact that Jehovah has given YOU the sabbath. That is why he is giving YOU on the sixth day the bread of two days. Keep sitting each one in his own place. Let nobody go out from his locality on the seventh day.”

1977.label: Exodus 16:30
1977.text: And the people proceeded to observe the sabbath on the seventh day.

1978.label: Exodus 16:31
1978.text: And the house of Israel began to call its name “manna.” And it was white like coriander seed, and its taste was like that of flat cakes with honey.

1979.label: Exodus 16:32
1979.text: Then Moses said: “This is the word that Jehovah has commanded, ‘Fill an omer measure of it as something to be kept throughout YOUR generations, in order that they may see the bread that I made YOU eat in the wilderness when I was bringing YOU out of the land of Egypt.’”

1980.label: Exodus 16:33
1980.text: So Moses said to Aaron: “Take a jar and put in it an omerful of manna and deposit it before Jehovah as something to be kept throughout YOUR generations.”

1981.label: Exodus 16:34
1981.text: Just as Jehovah had commanded Moses, Aaron proceeded to deposit it before the Testimony as something to be kept.

1982.label: Exodus 16:35
1982.text: And the sons of Israel ate the manna forty years, until their coming to a land inhabited. The manna was what they ate until their coming to the frontier of the land of Caʹnaan.

1983.label: Exodus 16:36
1983.text: Now an omer is a tenth of an eʹphah measure.

1984.label: Exodus 17:1
1984.text: And the entire assembly of the sons of Israel proceeded to depart from the wilderness of Sin by stages, which they took according to the order of Jehovah, and went camping at Rephʹi·dim. But there was no water for the people to drink.

1985.label: Exodus 17:2
1985.text: And the people fell to quarreling with Moses and saying: “Give us water that we may drink.” But Moses said to them: “Why are YOU quarreling with me? Why do YOU keep putting Jehovah to the test?”

1986.label: Exodus 17:3
1986.text: And the people went on thirsting there for water, and the people kept murmuring against Moses and saying: “Why is it that you have brought us up out of Egypt to put us and our sons and our livestock to death by thirst?”

1987.label: Exodus 17:4
1987.text: Finally Moses cried out to Jehovah, saying: “What shall I do with this people? A little longer and they will stone me!”

1988.label: Exodus 17:5
1988.text: Then Jehovah said to Moses: “Pass in front of the people and take with you some of the older men of Israel and your rod with which you struck the Nile River. Take it in your hand and you must walk on.

1989.label: Exodus 17:6
1989.text: Look! I am standing before you there on the rock in Hoʹreb. And you must strike on the rock, and water must come out of it, and the people must drink it.” Subsequently Moses did so under the eyes of the older men of Israel.

1990.label: Exodus 17:7
1990.text: So he called the name of the place Masʹsah and Merʹi·bah, because of the quarreling of the sons of Israel and because of their putting Jehovah to the test, saying: “Is Jehovah in our midst or not?”

1991.label: Exodus 17:8
1991.text: And the A·malʹek·ites proceeded to come and fight against Israel in Rephʹi·dim.

1992.label: Exodus 17:9
1992.text: At this Moses said to Joshua: “Choose men for us and go out, fight against the A·malʹek·ites. Tomorrow I am stationing myself upon the top of the hill, with the rod of the [true] God in my hand.”

1993.label: Exodus 17:10
1993.text: Then Joshua did just as Moses had said to him, in order to fight against the A·malʹek·ites; and Moses, Aaron and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

1994.label: Exodus 17:11
1994.text: And it occurred that as soon as Moses would lift his hand up, the Israelites proved superior; but as soon as he would let down his hand, the A·malʹek·ites proved superior.

1995.label: Exodus 17:12
1995.text: When the hands of Moses were heavy, then they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat upon it; and Aaron and Hur supported his hands, one on this side and the other on that side, so that his hands held steady until the sun set.

1996.label: Exodus 17:13
1996.text: Hence Joshua vanquished Amʹa·lek and his people with the edge of the sword.

1997.label: Exodus 17:14
1997.text: Jehovah now said to Moses: “Write this as a memorial in the book and propound it in Joshua’s ears, ‘I shall completely wipe out the remembrance of Amʹa·lek from under the heavens.’”

1998.label: Exodus 17:15
1998.text: And Moses proceeded to build an altar and to call its name Je·hoʹvah-nisʹsi,

1999.label: Exodus 17:16
1999.text: saying: “Because a hand is against the throne of Jah, Jehovah will have war with Amʹa·lek from generation to generation.”

2000.label: Exodus 18:1
2000.text: Now Jethʹro the priest of Midʹi·an, Moses’ father-in-law, got to hear about all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how Jehovah had brought Israel out of Egypt.

2001.label: Exodus 18:2
2001.text: So Jethʹro, Moses’ father-in-law, took Zip·poʹrah, Moses’ wife, after the sending of her away,

2002.label: Exodus 18:3
2002.text: and her two sons, the name of one of whom was Gerʹshom, “because,” he said, “an alien resident I have come to be in a foreign land”;

2003.label: Exodus 18:4
2003.text: and the name of the other was E·li·eʹzer, “because,” to quote him, “the God of my father is my helper in that he delivered me from Pharʹaoh’s sword.”

2004.label: Exodus 18:5
2004.text: So Jethʹro, Moses’ father-in-law, and his sons and his wife came to Moses into the wilderness where he was camping, at the mountain of the [true] God.

2005.label: Exodus 18:6
2005.text: Then he sent word to Moses: “I, your father-in-law, Jethʹro, am come to you, and also your wife and her two sons with her.”

2006.label: Exodus 18:7
2006.text: At once Moses went on out to meet his father-in-law, and he proceeded to prostrate himself and to kiss him; and they each one began asking how the other was getting along. After that they went into the tent.

2007.label: Exodus 18:8
2007.text: And Moses went to relating to his father-in-law all that Jehovah had done to Pharʹaoh and Egypt on account of Israel, and all the hardship that had befallen them in the way, and yet Jehovah was delivering them.

2008.label: Exodus 18:9
2008.text: Then Jethʹro felt glad over all the good that Jehovah had done for Israel in that he had delivered them from the hand of Egypt.

2009.label: Exodus 18:10
2009.text: Consequently Jethʹro said: “Blessed be Jehovah, who has delivered YOU from the hand of Egypt and from the hand of Pharʹaoh, and who has delivered the people from under the hand of Egypt.

2010.label: Exodus 18:11
2010.text: Now I do know that Jehovah is greater than all the [other] gods by reason of this affair in which they acted presumptuously against them.”

2011.label: Exodus 18:12
2011.text: Then Jethʹro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God; and Aaron and all the older men of Israel came to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law, before the [true] God.

2012.label: Exodus 18:13
2012.text: And it came about on the next day that Moses sat down as usual to serve as judge for the people, and the people kept standing before Moses from the morning till the evening.

2013.label: Exodus 18:14
2013.text: And Moses’ father-in-law got to see all that he was doing for the people. So he said: “What kind of business is this that you are doing for the people? Why do you alone continue sitting and all the people continue taking their stand before you from morning till evening?”

2014.label: Exodus 18:15
2014.text: Then Moses said to his father-in-law: “Because the people keep coming to me to inquire of God.

2015.label: Exodus 18:16
2015.text: In the event that they have a case arise, it must come to me and I must judge between the one party and the other, and I must make known the decisions of the [true] God and his laws.”

2016.label: Exodus 18:17
2016.text: At this Moses’ father-in-law said to him: “It is not good the way you are doing.

2017.label: Exodus 18:18
2017.text: You will surely wear out, both you and this people who are with you, because this business is too big a load for you. You are unable to do it by yourself.

2018.label: Exodus 18:19
2018.text: Now listen to my voice. I shall advise you, and God will prove to be with you. You yourself serve as representative for the people before the [true] God, and you yourself must bring the cases to the [true] God.

2019.label: Exodus 18:20
2019.text: And you must warn them of what the regulations and the laws are, and you must make known to them the way in which they should walk and the work that they should do.

2020.label: Exodus 18:21
2020.text: But you yourself should select out of all the people capable men, fearing God, trustworthy men, hating unjust profit; and you must set these over them as chiefs over thousands, chiefs over hundreds, chiefs over fifties and chiefs over tens.

2021.label: Exodus 18:22
2021.text: And they must judge the people on every proper occasion; and it must occur that every big case they will bring to you, but every small case they themselves will handle as judges. So make it lighter for yourself, and they must carry the load with you.

2022.label: Exodus 18:23
2022.text: If you do this very thing, and God has commanded you, you will then certainly be able to stand it and, besides, this people will all come to their own place in peace.”

2023.label: Exodus 18:24
2023.text: Immediately Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law and did all that he had said.

2024.label: Exodus 18:25
2024.text: And Moses proceeded to choose capable men out of all Israel and to give them positions as heads over the people, as chiefs of thousands, chiefs of hundreds, chiefs of fifties and chiefs of tens.

2025.label: Exodus 18:26
2025.text: And they judged the people on every proper occasion. A hard case they would bring to Moses, but every small case they themselves would handle as judges.

2026.label: Exodus 18:27
2026.text: After that Moses saw his father-in-law off, and he went his way to his land.

2027.label: Exodus 19:1
2027.text: In the third month after the sons of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, on the same day, they came into the wilderness of Siʹnai.

2028.label: Exodus 19:2
2028.text: And they proceeded to pull away from Rephʹi·dim and to come into the wilderness of Siʹnai and to encamp in the wilderness; and Israel went camping there in front of the mountain.

2029.label: Exodus 19:3
2029.text: And Moses went up to the [true] God, and Jehovah began to call to him out of the mountain, saying: “This is what you are to say to the house of Jacob and to tell the sons of Israel,

2030.label: Exodus 19:4
2030.text: ‘YOU yourselves have seen what I did to the Egyptians, that I might carry YOU on wings of eagles and bring YOU to myself.

2031.label: Exodus 19:5
2031.text: And now if YOU will strictly obey my voice and will indeed keep my covenant, then YOU will certainly become my special property out of all [other] peoples, because the whole earth belongs to me.

2032.label: Exodus 19:6
2032.text: And YOU yourselves will become to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you are to say to the sons of Israel.”

2033.label: Exodus 19:7
2033.text: So Moses came and called the older men of the people and set before them all these words that Jehovah had commanded him.

2034.label: Exodus 19:8
2034.text: After that all the people answered unanimously and said: “All that Jehovah has spoken we are willing to do.” Immediately Moses took back the words of the people to Jehovah.

2035.label: Exodus 19:9
2035.text: At this Jehovah said to Moses: “Look! I am coming to you in a dark cloud, in order that the people may hear when I speak with you, and that in you also they may put faith to time indefinite.” Then Moses reported the words of the people to Jehovah.

2036.label: Exodus 19:10
2036.text: And Jehovah went on to say to Moses: “Go to the people, and you must sanctify them today and tomorrow, and they must wash their mantles.

2037.label: Exodus 19:11
2037.text: And they must prove ready for the third day, because on the third day Jehovah will come down before the eyes of all the people upon Mount Siʹnai.

2038.label: Exodus 19:12
2038.text: And you must set bounds for the people round about, saying, ‘Guard yourselves against going up into the mountain, and do not touch the edge of it. Anybody touching the mountain will positively be put to death.

2039.label: Exodus 19:13
2039.text: No hand is to touch him, because he will positively be stoned or will positively be shot through. Whether beast or man, he will not live.’ At the blowing of the ram’s horn they themselves may come up to the mountain.”

2040.label: Exodus 19:14
2040.text: Then Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and he set about sanctifying the people; and they engaged in washing their mantles.

2041.label: Exodus 19:15
2041.text: Accordingly he said to the people: “Get ready during the three days. Do not YOU men come near a woman.”

2042.label: Exodus 19:16
2042.text: And on the third day when it became morning it came about that thunders and lightnings began occurring, and a heavy cloud upon the mountain and a very loud sound of a horn, so that all the people who were in the camp began to tremble.

2043.label: Exodus 19:17
2043.text: Moses now brought the people out of the camp to meet the [true] God, and they went taking their stand at the base of the mountain.

2044.label: Exodus 19:18
2044.text: And Mount Siʹnai smoked all over, due to the fact that Jehovah came down upon it in fire; and its smoke kept ascending like the smoke of a kiln, and the whole mountain was trembling very much.

2045.label: Exodus 19:19
2045.text: When the sound of the horn became continually louder and louder, Moses began to speak, and the [true] God began to answer him with a voice.

2046.label: Exodus 19:20
2046.text: So Jehovah came down upon Mount Siʹnai to the top of the mountain. Then Jehovah called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went on up.

2047.label: Exodus 19:21
2047.text: Jehovah now said to Moses: “Go down, warn the people, that they do not try to break through to Jehovah to take a look and many of them have to fall.

2048.label: Exodus 19:22
2048.text: And let the priests also who regularly come near to Jehovah sanctify themselves, that Jehovah may not break out upon them.”

2049.label: Exodus 19:23
2049.text: At this Moses said to Jehovah: “The people are not able to come up to Mount Siʹnai, because you yourself already warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds for the mountain and make it sacred.’”

2050.label: Exodus 19:24
2050.text: However, Jehovah said to him: “Go, descend, and you must come up, you and Aaron with you; but let not the priests and the people break through to come up to Jehovah, that he may not break out upon them.”

2051.label: Exodus 19:25
2051.text: Accordingly Moses descended to the people and told them.

2052.label: Exodus 20:1
2052.text: And God proceeded to speak all these words, saying:

2053.label: Exodus 20:2
2053.text: “I am Jehovah your God, who have brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slaves.

2054.label: Exodus 20:3
2054.text: You must not have any other gods against my face.

2055.label: Exodus 20:4
2055.text: “You must not make for yourself a carved image or a form like anything that is in the heavens above or that is on the earth underneath or that is in the waters under the earth.

2056.label: Exodus 20:5
2056.text: You must not bow down to them nor be induced to serve them, because I Jehovah your God am a God exacting exclusive devotion, bringing punishment for the error of fathers upon sons, upon the third generation and upon the fourth generation, in the case of those who hate me;

2057.label: Exodus 20:6
2057.text: but exercising loving-kindness toward the thousandth generation in the case of those who love me and keep my commandments.

2058.label: Exodus 20:7
2058.text: “You must not take up the name of Jehovah your God in a worthless way, for Jehovah will not leave the one unpunished who takes up his name in a worthless way.

2059.label: Exodus 20:8
2059.text: “Remembering the sabbath day to hold it sacred,

2060.label: Exodus 20:9
2060.text: you are to render service and you must do all your work six days.

2061.label: Exodus 20:10
2061.text: But the seventh day is a sabbath to Jehovah your God. You must not do any work, you nor your son nor your daughter, your slave man nor your slave girl nor your domestic animal nor your alien resident who is inside your gates.

2062.label: Exodus 20:11
2062.text: For in six days Jehovah made the heavens and the earth, the sea and everything that is in them, and he proceeded to rest on the seventh day. That is why Jehovah blessed the sabbath day and proceeded to make it sacred.

2063.label: Exodus 20:12
2063.text: “Honor your father and your mother in order that your days may prove long upon the ground that Jehovah your God is giving you.

2067.label: Exodus 20:16
2067.text: “You must not testify falsely as a witness against your fellowman.

2068.label: Exodus 20:17
2068.text: “You must not desire your fellowman’s house. You must not desire your fellowman’s wife, nor his slave man nor his slave girl nor his bull nor his ass nor anything that belongs to your fellowman.”

2069.label: Exodus 20:18
2069.text: Now all the people were seeing the thunders and the lightning flashes and the sound of the horn and the mountain smoking. When the people got to see it, then they quivered and stood at a distance.

2070.label: Exodus 20:19
2070.text: And they began to say to Moses: “You speak with us, and let us listen; but let not God speak with us for fear we may die.”

2071.label: Exodus 20:20
2071.text: So Moses said to the people: “Do not be afraid, because for the sake of putting YOU to the test the [true] God has come, and in order that the fear of him may continue before YOUR faces that YOU may not sin.”

2072.label: Exodus 20:21
2072.text: And the people kept standing at a distance, but Moses went near to the dark cloud mass where the [true] God was.

2073.label: Exodus 20:22
2073.text: And Jehovah went on to say to Moses: “This is what you are to say to the sons of Israel, ‘YOU yourselves have seen that it was from the heavens I spoke with YOU.

2074.label: Exodus 20:23
2074.text: YOU must not make along with me gods of silver, and YOU must not make gods of gold for yourselves.

2075.label: Exodus 20:24
2075.text: An altar of ground you are to make for me, and you must sacrifice upon it your burnt offerings and your communion sacrifices, your flock and your herd. In every place where I shall cause my name to be remembered I shall come to you and shall certainly bless you.

2076.label: Exodus 20:25
2076.text: And if you should make an altar of stones for me, you must not build them as hewn stones. In the event that you do wield your chisel upon it, then you will profane it.

2077.label: Exodus 20:26
2077.text: And you must not go up by steps to my altar, that your private parts may not be exposed upon it.’

2078.label: Exodus 21:1
2078.text: “And these are the judicial decisions that you are to set before them:

2079.label: Exodus 21:2
2079.text: “In case you should buy a Hebrew slave, he will be a slave six years, but in the seventh he will go out as one set free without charge.

2080.label: Exodus 21:3
2080.text: If he should come in by himself, by himself he will go out. If he is the owner of a wife, then his wife must go out with him.

2081.label: Exodus 21:4
2081.text: If his master should give him a wife and she does bear him sons or daughters, the wife and her children will become her master’s and he will go out by himself.

2082.label: Exodus 21:5
2082.text: But if the slave should insistently say, ‘I really love my master, my wife and my sons; I do not want to go out as one set free,’

2083.label: Exodus 21:6
2083.text: then his master must bring him near to the [true] God and must bring him up against the door or the doorpost; and his master must pierce his ear through with an awl, and he must be his slave to time indefinite.

2084.label: Exodus 21:7
2084.text: “And in case a man should sell his daughter as a slave girl, she will not go out in the way that the slave men go out.

2085.label: Exodus 21:8
2085.text: If she is displeasing in the eyes of her master so that he does not designate her as a concubine but causes her to be redeemed, he will not be entitled to sell her to a foreign people in his treacherously dealing with her.

2086.label: Exodus 21:9
2086.text: And if it should be to his son that he designates her, he is to do to her according to the due right of daughters.

2087.label: Exodus 21:10
2087.text: If he should take another wife for himself, her sustenance, her clothing and her marriage due are not to be diminished.

2088.label: Exodus 21:11
2088.text: If he will not render these three things to her, then she must go out for nothing, without money.

2089.label: Exodus 21:12
2089.text: “One who strikes a man so that he actually dies is to be put to death without fail.

2090.label: Exodus 21:13
2090.text: But where one does not lie in wait and the [true] God lets it occur at his hand, then I must fix for you a place where he can flee.

2091.label: Exodus 21:14
2091.text: And in case a man becomes heated against his fellow to the point of killing him with craftiness, you are to take him even from being at my altar to die.

2092.label: Exodus 21:15
2092.text: And one who strikes his father and his mother is to be put to death without fail.

2093.label: Exodus 21:16
2093.text: “And one who kidnaps a man and who actually sells him or in whose hand he has been found is to be put to death without fail.

2094.label: Exodus 21:17
2094.text: “And one who calls down evil upon his father and his mother is to be put to death without fail.

2095.label: Exodus 21:18
2095.text: “And in case men should get into a quarrel and one does strike his fellow with a stone or a hoe and he does not die but must keep to his bed;

2096.label: Exodus 21:19
2096.text: if he gets up and does walk about out of doors upon some support of his, then the one who struck him must be free from punishment; he will make compensation only for the time lost from that one’s work until he gets him completely healed.

2097.label: Exodus 21:20
2097.text: “And in case a man strikes his slave man or his slave girl with a stick and that one actually dies under his hand, that one is to be avenged without fail.

2098.label: Exodus 21:21
2098.text: However, if he lingers for a day or two days, he is not to be avenged, because he is his money.

2099.label: Exodus 21:22
2099.text: “And in case men should struggle with each other and they really hurt a pregnant woman and her children do come out but no fatal accident occurs, he is to have damages imposed upon him without fail according to what the owner of the woman may lay upon him; and he must give it through the justices.

2100.label: Exodus 21:23
2100.text: But if a fatal accident should occur, then you must give soul for soul,

2101.label: Exodus 21:24
2101.text: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

2102.label: Exodus 21:25
2102.text: branding for branding, wound for wound, blow for blow.

2103.label: Exodus 21:26
2103.text: “And in case a man should strike the eye of his slave man or the eye of his slave girl and he really ruins it, he is to send him away as one set free in compensation for his eye.

2104.label: Exodus 21:27
2104.text: And if it should be the tooth of his slave man or the tooth of his slave girl that he knocks out, he is to send him away as one set free in compensation for his tooth.

2105.label: Exodus 21:28
2105.text: “And in case a bull should gore a man or a woman and that one actually dies, the bull is to be stoned without fail, but its flesh is not to be eaten; and the owner of the bull is free from punishment.

2106.label: Exodus 21:29
2106.text: But if a bull was formerly in the habit of goring and warning was served on its owner but he would not keep it under guard, and it did put a man or a woman to death, the bull is to be stoned and also its owner is to be put to death.

2107.label: Exodus 21:30
2107.text: If a ransom should be imposed upon him, then he must give the redemption price for his soul according to all that may be imposed upon him.

2108.label: Exodus 21:31
2108.text: Whether it gored a son or gored a daughter, it is to be done to him according to this judicial decision.

2109.label: Exodus 21:32
2109.text: If it was a slave man or a slave girl that the bull gored, he will give the price of thirty shekels to that one’s master, and the bull will be stoned.

2110.label: Exodus 21:33
2110.text: “And in case a man should open a pit, or in case a man should excavate a pit and should not cover it, and a bull or an ass does fall into it,

2111.label: Exodus 21:34
2111.text: the owner of the pit is to make compensation. The price he is to return to its owner, and the dead animal will become his own.

2112.label: Exodus 21:35
2112.text: And in case a man’s bull should hurt another’s bull and it does die, then they must sell the live bull and divide the price paid for it; and also the dead one they should divide.

2113.label: Exodus 21:36
2113.text: Or if it was known that a bull was in the habit of goring formerly but its owner would not keep it under guard, he should without fail make compensation with bull for bull, and the dead one will become his own.

2114.label: Exodus 22:1
2114.text: “In case a man should steal a bull or a sheep and he does slaughter it or sell it, he is to compensate with five of the herd for the bull and four of the flock for the sheep.

2115.label: Exodus 22:2
2115.text: (“If a thief should be found in the act of breaking in and he does get struck and die, there is no bloodguilt for him.

2116.label: Exodus 22:3
2116.text: If the sun has shone forth upon him, there is bloodguilt for him.) “He is to make compensation without fail. If he has nothing, then he must be sold for the things he stole.

2117.label: Exodus 22:4
2117.text: If there should be unmistakably found in his hand what was stolen, from bull to ass and to sheep, alive, he is to make double compensation.

2118.label: Exodus 22:5
2118.text: “If a man causes a field or a vineyard to be grazed over and he does send out his beasts of burden and cause a consuming in another field, he is to make compensation with the best of his own field or with the best of his own vineyard.

2119.label: Exodus 22:6
2119.text: “In case a fire should spread out and it does catch thorns, and sheaves or standing grain or a field gets consumed, the one who started the fire is to make compensation without fail [for what was burned].

2120.label: Exodus 22:7
2120.text: “In case a man should give his fellow money or articles to keep, and it gets stolen from the man’s house, if the thief should be found, he is to make double compensation.

2121.label: Exodus 22:8
2121.text: If the thief should not be found, then the owner of the house must be brought near to the [true] God to see whether he did not put his hand upon the goods of his fellow.

2122.label: Exodus 22:9
2122.text: As regards any case of transgression, concerning a bull, an ass, a sheep, a garment, anything lost of which he may say, ‘This is it!’ the case of them both is to come to the [true] God. The one whom God will pronounce wicked is to make double compensation to his fellow.

2123.label: Exodus 22:10
2123.text: “In case a man should give his fellow an ass or bull or sheep or any domestic animal to keep, and it does die or get maimed or gets led off while nobody is looking,

2124.label: Exodus 22:11
2124.text: an oath by Jehovah is to take place between them both that he did not put his hand on the goods of his fellow; and their owner must accept it, and the other is not to make compensation.

2125.label: Exodus 22:12
2125.text: But if they should for a fact be stolen from him, he is to make compensation to their owner.

2126.label: Exodus 22:13
2126.text: If it should for a fact be torn by a wild beast, he is to bring it as evidence. For something torn by a wild beast he is not to make compensation.

2127.label: Exodus 22:14
2127.text: “But in case anybody should ask for something of his fellow, and it does get maimed or die while its owner is not with it, he is to make compensation without fail.

2128.label: Exodus 22:15
2128.text: If its owner is with it, he is not to make compensation. If it is hired, it must come in its hire.

2129.label: Exodus 22:16
2129.text: “Now in case a man seduces a virgin who is not engaged, and he actually lies down with her, he is to obtain her without fail as his wife for the purchase price.

2130.label: Exodus 22:17
2130.text: If her father flatly refuses to give her to him, he is to pay over the money at the rate of purchase money for virgins.

2131.label: Exodus 22:18
2131.text: “You must not preserve a sorceress alive.

2132.label: Exodus 22:19
2132.text: “Anyone lying down with a beast is positively to be put to death.

2133.label: Exodus 22:20
2133.text: “One who sacrifices to any gods but Jehovah alone is to be devoted to destruction.

2134.label: Exodus 22:21
2134.text: “And you must not maltreat an alien resident or oppress him, for YOU people became alien residents in the land of Egypt.

2135.label: Exodus 22:22
2135.text: “YOU people must not afflict any widow or fatherless boy.

2136.label: Exodus 22:23
2136.text: If you should afflict him at all, then if he cries out to me at all, I shall unfailingly hear his outcry;

2137.label: Exodus 22:24
2137.text: and my anger will indeed blaze, and I shall certainly kill YOU with the sword, and YOUR wives must become widows and YOUR sons fatherless boys.

2138.label: Exodus 22:25
2138.text: “If you should lend money to my people, to the afflicted alongside you, you must not become like a usurer to him. YOU must not lay interest upon him.

2139.label: Exodus 22:26
2139.text: “If you should at all seize the garment of your fellow as a pledge, you are to return it to him at the setting of the sun.

2140.label: Exodus 22:27
2140.text: For it is his only covering. It is his mantle for his skin. In what will he lie down? And it must occur that he will cry out to me, and I shall certainly hear, because I am gracious.

2141.label: Exodus 22:28
2141.text: “You must not call down evil upon God nor curse a chieftain among your people.

2142.label: Exodus 22:29
2142.text: “Your full produce and the overflow of your press you must not give hesitantly. The firstborn of your sons you are to give to me.

2143.label: Exodus 22:30
2143.text: The way you are to do with your bull and your sheep is this: Seven days it will continue with its mother. On the eighth day you are to give it to me.

2144.label: Exodus 22:31
2144.text: “And YOU should prove yourselves holy men to me; and YOU must not eat flesh in the field that is something torn by a wild beast. YOU should throw it to the dogs.

2145.label: Exodus 23:1
2145.text: “You must not take up an untrue report. Do not cooperate with a wicked one by becoming a witness who schemes violence.

2146.label: Exodus 23:2
2146.text: You must not follow after the crowd for evil ends; and you must not testify over a controversy so as to turn aside with the crowd in order to pervert justice.

2147.label: Exodus 23:3
2147.text: As for the lowly one, you must not show preference in a controversy of his.

2148.label: Exodus 23:4
2148.text: “Should you come upon your enemy’s bull or his ass going astray, you are to return it without fail to him.

2149.label: Exodus 23:5
2149.text: Should you see the ass of someone who hates you lying down under its load, then you must refrain from leaving him. With him you are without fail to get it loose.

2150.label: Exodus 23:6
2150.text: “You are not to pervert the judicial decision of your poor man in his controversy.

2151.label: Exodus 23:7
2151.text: “You are to keep far from a false word. And do not kill the innocent and the righteous, for I shall not declare the wicked one righteous.

2152.label: Exodus 23:8
2152.text: “You are not to accept a bribe, for the bribe blinds clear-sighted men and can distort the words of righteous men.

2153.label: Exodus 23:9
2153.text: “And you must not oppress an alien resident, as YOU yourselves have known the soul of the alien resident, because YOU became alien residents in the land of Egypt.

2154.label: Exodus 23:10
2154.text: “And for six years you are to sow your land with seed and you must gather its produce.

2155.label: Exodus 23:11
2155.text: But the seventh year you are to leave it uncultivated and you must let it lie fallow, and the poor ones of your people must eat of it; and what is left over by them the wild beasts of the field are to eat. That is the way you are to do with your vineyard and your olive grove.

2156.label: Exodus 23:12
2156.text: “Six days you are to do your work; but on the seventh day you are to desist, in order that your bull and your ass may rest and the son of your slave girl and the alien resident may refresh themselves.

2157.label: Exodus 23:13
2157.text: “And YOU are to be on your guard respecting all that I have said to YOU; and YOU must not mention the name of other gods. It should not be heard upon your mouth.

2158.label: Exodus 23:14
2158.text: “Three times in the year you are to celebrate a festival to me.

2159.label: Exodus 23:15
2159.text: You will keep the festival of unfermented cakes. You will eat unfermented cakes seven days, just as I have commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of Aʹbib, because in it you came out of Egypt. And they must not appear before me empty-handed.

2160.label: Exodus 23:16
2160.text: Also, the festival of harvest of the first ripe fruits of your labors, of what you sow in the field; and the festival of ingathering at the outgoing of the year, when you gather in your labors from the field.

2161.label: Exodus 23:17
2161.text: On three occasions in the year every male of yours will appear before the face of the [true] Lord, Jehovah.

2162.label: Exodus 23:18
2162.text: “You must not sacrifice along with what is leavened the blood of my sacrifice. And the fat of my festival should not stay overnight until morning.

2163.label: Exodus 23:19
2163.text: “The best of the first ripe fruits of your ground you are to bring to the house of Jehovah your God. “You must not boil a kid in its mother’s milk.

2164.label: Exodus 23:20
2164.text: “Here I am sending an angel ahead of you to keep you on the road and to bring you into the place that I have prepared.

2165.label: Exodus 23:21
2165.text: Watch yourself because of him and obey his voice. Do not behave rebelliously against him, for he will not pardon YOUR transgression; because my name is within him.

2166.label: Exodus 23:22
2166.text: However, if you strictly obey his voice and really do all that I shall speak, then I shall certainly be hostile to your enemies and harass those who harass you.

2167.label: Exodus 23:23
2167.text: For my angel will go ahead of you and will indeed bring you to the Amʹor·ites and the Hitʹtites and the Perʹiz·zites and the Caʹnaan·ites, the Hiʹvites and the Jebʹu·sites, and I shall certainly efface them.

2168.label: Exodus 23:24
2168.text: You must not bow down to their gods or be induced to serve them, and you must not make anything like their works, but you will without fail throw them down and you will without fail break down their sacred pillars.

2169.label: Exodus 23:25
2169.text: And YOU must serve Jehovah YOUR God, and he will certainly bless your bread and your water; and I shall indeed turn malady away from your midst.

2170.label: Exodus 23:26
2170.text: Neither a woman suffering an abortion nor a barren woman will exist in your land. I shall make the number of your days full.

2171.label: Exodus 23:27
2171.text: “And I shall send the fright of me ahead of you, and I shall certainly throw into confusion all the people among whom you come, and I shall indeed give the back of the neck of all your enemies to you.

2172.label: Exodus 23:28
2172.text: And I will send the feeling of dejection ahead of you, and it will simply drive the Hiʹvites, the Caʹnaan·ites and the Hitʹtites out from before you.

2173.label: Exodus 23:29
2173.text: I shall not drive them out from before you in one year, that the land may not become a desolate waste and the wild beasts of the field really multiply against you.

2174.label: Exodus 23:30
2174.text: Little by little I shall drive them out from before you, until you become fruitful and really take possession of the land.

2175.label: Exodus 23:31
2175.text: “And I will fix your boundary from the Red Sea to the sea of the Phi·lisʹtines and from the wilderness to the River; because I shall give into YOUR hand the inhabitants of the land, and you will certainly drive them out from before yourself.

2176.label: Exodus 23:32
2176.text: You are not to conclude a covenant with them or their gods.

2177.label: Exodus 23:33
2177.text: They should not dwell in your land, that they may not cause you to sin against me. In case you should serve their gods, it would become a snare to you.”

2178.label: Exodus 24:1
2178.text: And to Moses he said: “Go up to Jehovah, you and Aaron, Naʹdab and A·biʹhu and seventy of the older men of Israel, and YOU must bow down from a distance.

2179.label: Exodus 24:2
2179.text: And Moses by himself must approach Jehovah; but they should not approach, and the people should not go up with him.”

2180.label: Exodus 24:3
2180.text: Then Moses came and related to the people all the words of Jehovah and all the judicial decisions, and all the people answered with one voice and said: “All the words that Jehovah has spoken we are willing to do.”

2181.label: Exodus 24:4
2181.text: Accordingly Moses wrote down all the words of Jehovah. Then he got up early in the morning and built at the foot of the mountain an altar and twelve pillars corresponding with the twelve tribes of Israel.

2182.label: Exodus 24:5
2182.text: After that he sent young men of the sons of Israel and they offered up burnt offerings and sacrificed bulls as sacrifices, as communion sacrifices to Jehovah.

2183.label: Exodus 24:6
2183.text: Then Moses took half the blood and put it in bowls, and half the blood he sprinkled upon the altar.

2184.label: Exodus 24:7
2184.text: Finally he took the book of the covenant and read it in the ears of the people. Then they said: “All that Jehovah has spoken we are willing to do and be obedient.”

2185.label: Exodus 24:8
2185.text: So Moses took the blood and sprinkled it upon the people and said: “Here is the blood of the covenant that Jehovah has concluded with YOU as respects all these words.”

2186.label: Exodus 24:9
2186.text: And Moses and Aaron, Naʹdab and A·biʹhu and seventy of the older men of Israel proceeded to go up,

2187.label: Exodus 24:10
2187.text: and they got to see the God of Israel. And under his feet there was what seemed like a work of sapphire flagstones and like the very heavens for purity.

2188.label: Exodus 24:11
2188.text: And he did not put out his hand against the distinguished men of the sons of Israel, but they got a vision of the [true] God and ate and drank.

2189.label: Exodus 24:12
2189.text: Jehovah now said to Moses: “Come up to me in the mountain and stay there, as I want to give you the stone tablets and the law and the commandment that I must write in order to teach them.”

2190.label: Exodus 24:13
2190.text: So Moses and Joshua his minister got up and Moses went up into the mountain of the [true] God.

2191.label: Exodus 24:14
2191.text: But to the older men he had said: “YOU wait for us in this place until we return to YOU. And, look! Aaron and Hur are with YOU. Whoever has a case at law, let him approach them.”

2192.label: Exodus 24:15
2192.text: Thus Moses went up into the mountain while the cloud was covering the mountain.

2193.label: Exodus 24:16
2193.text: And Jehovah’s glory continued to reside upon Mount Siʹnai, and the cloud continued to cover it for six days. At length on the seventh day he called to Moses from the midst of the cloud.

2194.label: Exodus 24:17
2194.text: And to the eyes of the sons of Israel the sight of Jehovah’s glory was like a devouring fire on the mountaintop.

2195.label: Exodus 24:18
2195.text: Then Moses entered into the midst of the cloud and went on up the mountain. And Moses continued in the mountain forty days and forty nights.

2196.label: Exodus 25:1
2196.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses, saying:

2197.label: Exodus 25:2
2197.text: “Speak to the sons of Israel, that they may take up a contribution for me: From every man whose heart incites him YOU people are to take up the contribution of mine.

2198.label: Exodus 25:3
2198.text: And this is the contribution that YOU are to take up from them: gold and silver and copper,

2199.label: Exodus 25:4
2199.text: and blue thread, and wool dyed reddish purple, and coccus scarlet material, and fine linen, and goat’s hair,

2200.label: Exodus 25:5
2200.text: and ram skins dyed red, and sealskins, and acacia wood;

2201.label: Exodus 25:6
2201.text: oil for the luminary, balsam oil for the anointing oil and for perfumed incense;

2202.label: Exodus 25:7
2202.text: and onyx stones and setting stones for the ephʹod and for the breastpiece.

2203.label: Exodus 25:8
2203.text: And they must make a sanctuary for me, as I must tabernacle in the midst of them.

2204.label: Exodus 25:9
2204.text: According to all that I am showing you as the pattern of the tabernacle and pattern of all its furnishings, that is the way YOU are to make it.

2205.label: Exodus 25:10
2205.text: “And they must make an Ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits its length and a cubit and a half its width and a cubit and a half its height.

2206.label: Exodus 25:11
2206.text: And you must overlay it with pure gold. Inside and outside you are to overlay it, and you must make a border of gold round about upon it.

2207.label: Exodus 25:12
2207.text: And you must cast four rings of gold for it and put them above its four feet, with two rings upon the one side of it and two rings upon its other side.

2208.label: Exodus 25:13
2208.text: And you must make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

2209.label: Exodus 25:14
2209.text: And you must put the poles through the rings upon the sides of the Ark in order to carry the Ark with them.

2210.label: Exodus 25:15
2210.text: In the rings of the Ark the poles are to stay. They are not to be removed from it.

2211.label: Exodus 25:16
2211.text: And you must place in the Ark the testimony that I shall give you.

2212.label: Exodus 25:17
2212.text: “And you must make a cover of pure gold, two and a half cubits its length and a cubit and a half its width.

2213.label: Exodus 25:18
2213.text: And you must make two cherubs of gold. Of hammered work you are to make them on both ends of the cover.

2214.label: Exodus 25:19
2214.text: And make one cherub on this end and one cherub on that end. On the cover YOU are to make the cherubs at its two ends.

2215.label: Exodus 25:20
2215.text: And the cherubs must be spreading out their two wings upward, screening over the cover with their wings, with their faces one toward the other. Toward the cover the faces of the cherubs should be.

2216.label: Exodus 25:21
2216.text: And you must place the cover above upon the Ark, and in the Ark you will place the testimony that I shall give you.

2217.label: Exodus 25:22
2217.text: And I will present myself to you there and speak with you from above the cover, from between the two cherubs that are upon the ark of the testimony, even all that I shall command you for the sons of Israel.

2218.label: Exodus 25:23
2218.text: “And you must make a table of acacia wood, two cubits its length and a cubit its width and a cubit and a half its height.

2219.label: Exodus 25:24
2219.text: And you must overlay it with pure gold, and you must make for it a border of gold round about.

2220.label: Exodus 25:25
2220.text: And you must make for it a rim of a handbreadth round about, and you must make the border of gold for its rim round about.

2221.label: Exodus 25:26
2221.text: And you must make for it four rings of gold and place the rings on the four corners that are for the four feet.

2222.label: Exodus 25:27
2222.text: The rings should be close by the rim as supports for the poles to carry the table.

2223.label: Exodus 25:28
2223.text: And you must make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, and they must carry the table with them.

2224.label: Exodus 25:29
2224.text: “And you must make its dishes and its cups and its pitchers and its bowls with which they will pour [libations]. You are to make them out of pure gold.

2225.label: Exodus 25:30
2225.text: And you must put the showbread upon the table before me constantly.

2226.label: Exodus 25:31
2226.text: “And you must make a lampstand of pure gold. Of hammered work the lampstand is to be made. Its base, its branches, its cups, its knobs and its blossoms are to proceed out from it.

2227.label: Exodus 25:32
2227.text: And six branches are running out from its sides, three branches of the lampstand from its one side and three branches of the lampstand from its other side.

2228.label: Exodus 25:33
2228.text: Three cups shaped like flowers of almond are on the one set of branches, with knobs and blossoms alternating, and three cups shaped like flowers of almond on the other set of branches, with knobs and blossoms alternating. This is the way it is with the six branches running out from the lampstand.

2229.label: Exodus 25:34
2229.text: And on the lampstand are four cups shaped like flowers of almond, with its knobs and its blossoms alternating.

2230.label: Exodus 25:35
2230.text: And the knob under two branches is out of it and the knob under the two other branches is out of it and the knob under two more branches is out of it, for the six branches running out from the lampstand.

2231.label: Exodus 25:36
2231.text: Their knobs and their branches are to proceed out from it. All of it is one piece of hammered work, of pure gold.

2232.label: Exodus 25:37
2232.text: And you must make seven lamps for it; and the lamps must be lit up, and they must shine upon the area in front of it.

2233.label: Exodus 25:38
2233.text: And its snuffers and its fire holders are of pure gold.

2234.label: Exodus 25:39
2234.text: Of a talent of pure gold he should make it with all these utensils of it.

2235.label: Exodus 25:40
2235.text: And see that you make them after their pattern that was shown to you in the mountain.

2236.label: Exodus 26:1
2236.text: “And the tabernacle you are to make of ten tent cloths, of fine twisted linen and blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material. With cherubs, the work of an embroiderer, you will make them.

2237.label: Exodus 26:2
2237.text: The length of each tent cloth is twenty-eight cubits and the width of each tent cloth is four cubits. There is one measure for all the tent cloths.

2238.label: Exodus 26:3
2238.text: Five tent cloths are to form a series with the one joined to the other, and five tent cloths a series with the one joined to the other.

2239.label: Exodus 26:4
2239.text: And you must make loops of blue thread upon the edge of the one tent cloth at the end of the series; and you are to do the same upon the edge of the outermost tent cloth at the other place of junction.

2240.label: Exodus 26:5
2240.text: You will make fifty loops on the one tent cloth, and fifty loops you will make on the extremity of the tent cloth that is at the other place of junction, the loops being opposite one to the other.

2241.label: Exodus 26:6
2241.text: And you must make fifty hooks of gold and join the tent cloths one to the other by means of the hooks, and it must become one tabernacle.

2242.label: Exodus 26:7
2242.text: “And you must make cloths of goat’s hair for the tent upon the tabernacle. You will make eleven tent cloths.

2243.label: Exodus 26:8
2243.text: The length of each tent cloth is thirty cubits, and the width of each tent cloth is four cubits. There is one measure for the eleven tent cloths.

2244.label: Exodus 26:9
2244.text: And you must join five tent cloths by themselves and six tent cloths by themselves, and you must fold double the sixth tent cloth at the forefront of the tent.

2245.label: Exodus 26:10
2245.text: And you must make fifty loops upon the edge of the one tent cloth, the outermost one in the series, and fifty loops upon the edge of the tent cloth at the other place of junction.

2246.label: Exodus 26:11
2246.text: And you must make fifty hooks of copper and put the hooks in the loops and join the tent together, and it must become one.

2247.label: Exodus 26:12
2247.text: And what remains over of the cloths of the tent is an overhanging. Half of the tent cloth that remains over is to hang over the back of the tabernacle.

2248.label: Exodus 26:13
2248.text: And the cubit on this side and the cubit on that side in what remains over in the length of the cloths of the tent will serve as an overhanging on the sides of the tabernacle, to cover it on this side and on that.

2249.label: Exodus 26:14
2249.text: “And you must make a covering for the tent of ram skins dyed red and a covering of sealskins up on top.

2250.label: Exodus 26:15
2250.text: “And you must make the panel frames for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing on end.

2251.label: Exodus 26:16
2251.text: Ten cubits is the length of a panel frame, and a cubit and a half is the width of each panel frame.

2252.label: Exodus 26:17
2252.text: Each panel frame has two tenons joined one to the other. That is the way you will do with all the panel frames of the tabernacle.

2253.label: Exodus 26:18
2253.text: And you must make the panel frames for the tabernacle, twenty panel frames for the side toward the Negʹeb, to the south.

2254.label: Exodus 26:19
2254.text: “And you will make forty socket pedestals of silver under the twenty panel frames; two socket pedestals under the one panel frame with its two tenons, and two socket pedestals under the other panel frame with its two tenons.

2255.label: Exodus 26:20
2255.text: And for the other side of the tabernacle, the northern side, twenty panel frames,

2256.label: Exodus 26:21
2256.text: and their forty socket pedestals of silver, two socket pedestals under the one panel frame and two socket pedestals under the other panel frame.

2257.label: Exodus 26:22
2257.text: And for the rear sections of the tabernacle to the west you will make six panel frames.

2258.label: Exodus 26:23
2258.text: And you will make two panel frames as corner posts of the tabernacle on its two rear sections.

2259.label: Exodus 26:24
2259.text: And they should be duplicates at the bottom, and together they should be duplicates up to the top of each one at the first ring. That is the way it should be for the two of them. They will serve as two corner posts.

2260.label: Exodus 26:25
2260.text: And there must be eight panel frames and their socket pedestals of silver, sixteen pedestals, two socket pedestals under the one panel frame and two socket pedestals under the other panel frame.

2261.label: Exodus 26:26
2261.text: “And you must make bars of acacia wood, five for the panel frames of the one side of the tabernacle,

2262.label: Exodus 26:27
2262.text: and five bars for the panel frames of the other side of the tabernacle and five bars for the panel frames of the side of the tabernacle for the two rear sections to the west.

2263.label: Exodus 26:28
2263.text: And the middle bar at the center of the panel frames is running through from end to end.

2264.label: Exodus 26:29
2264.text: “And you will overlay the panel frames with gold, and their rings you will make of gold as supports for the bars; and you must overlay the bars with gold.

2265.label: Exodus 26:30
2265.text: And you must set up the tabernacle according to the plan of it that you have been shown in the mountain.

2266.label: Exodus 26:31
2266.text: “And you must make a curtain of blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen. He will make it with cherubs, the work of an embroiderer.

2267.label: Exodus 26:32
2267.text: And you must put it upon four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold. Their pegs are of gold. They are upon four socket pedestals of silver.

2268.label: Exodus 26:33
2268.text: And you must put the curtain under the hooks and bring the ark of the testimony there within the curtain; and the curtain must make a division for YOU between the Holy and the Most Holy.

2269.label: Exodus 26:34
2269.text: And you must put the cover upon the ark of the testimony in the Most Holy.

2270.label: Exodus 26:35
2270.text: “And you must set the table outside the curtain, and the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south; and the table you will put on the north side.

2271.label: Exodus 26:36
2271.text: And you must make a screen for the entrance of the tent of blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen, the work of a weaver.

2272.label: Exodus 26:37
2272.text: And you must make for the screen five pillars of acacia and overlay them with gold. Their pegs are of gold. And you must cast for them five socket pedestals of copper.

2273.label: Exodus 27:1
2273.text: “And you must make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits its length and five cubits its width. The altar should be foursquare, and its height three cubits.

2274.label: Exodus 27:2
2274.text: And you must make its horns upon its four corners. Its horns will proceed out of it, and you must overlay it with copper.

2275.label: Exodus 27:3
2275.text: And you must make its cans for clearing away its fatty ashes, and its shovels, and its bowls, and its forks, and its fire holders; and you will make all its utensils of copper.

2276.label: Exodus 27:4
2276.text: And you must make a grating for it, a network of copper; and you must make upon the net four rings of copper at its four extremities.

2277.label: Exodus 27:5
2277.text: And you must put it under the altar’s rim down within, and the net must be toward the center of the altar.

2278.label: Exodus 27:6
2278.text: And you must make poles for the altar, its poles being of acacia wood, and you must overlay them with copper.

2279.label: Exodus 27:7
2279.text: And its poles must be put into the rings, and the poles must be upon the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

2280.label: Exodus 27:8
2280.text: A hollow chest of planks you will make it. Just as he showed you in the mountain, so they will make it.

2281.label: Exodus 27:9
2281.text: “And you must make the courtyard of the tabernacle. For the side toward the Negʹeb, to the south, the courtyard has hangings of fine twisted linen, a hundred cubits being the length for the one side.

2282.label: Exodus 27:10
2282.text: And its twenty pillars and their twenty socket pedestals are of copper. The pegs of the pillars and their joints are of silver.

2283.label: Exodus 27:11
2283.text: So, too, it is for the north side in length, the hangings being for a hundred cubits of length, and its twenty pillars and their twenty socket pedestals being of copper, the pegs of the pillars and their joints being of silver.

2284.label: Exodus 27:12
2284.text: As for the width of the courtyard, on the west side the hangings are of fifty cubits, their pillars being ten and their socket pedestals ten.

2285.label: Exodus 27:13
2285.text: And the width of the courtyard on the east side toward the sunrising is fifty cubits.

2286.label: Exodus 27:14
2286.text: And there are fifteen cubits of hangings to one side, their pillars being three and their socket pedestals three.

2287.label: Exodus 27:15
2287.text: And for the other side there are fifteen cubits of hangings, their pillars being three and their socket pedestals three.

2288.label: Exodus 27:16
2288.text: “And for the gate of the courtyard there is a screen twenty cubits long, of blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen, the work of a weaver, their pillars being four and their socket pedestals four.

2289.label: Exodus 27:17
2289.text: All the pillars of the courtyard round about have fastenings of silver, and their pegs are of silver but their socket pedestals of copper.

2290.label: Exodus 27:18
2290.text: The length of the courtyard is a hundred cubits, and the width fifty cubits, and the height five cubits, of fine twisted linen, and their socket pedestals being of copper.

2291.label: Exodus 27:19
2291.text: And all the utensils of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its tent pins, and all the pins of the courtyard are of copper.

2292.label: Exodus 27:20
2292.text: “As for you, you are to command the sons of Israel that they get for you pure, beaten olive oil for the luminary, in order to light up the lamps constantly.

2293.label: Exodus 27:21
2293.text: In the tent of meeting, outside the curtain that is by the Testimony, Aaron and his sons will set it in order from evening till morning before Jehovah. It is a statute to time indefinite for their generations, to be performed by the sons of Israel.

2294.label: Exodus 28:1
2294.text: “And as for you, bring near to yourself Aaron your brother and his sons with him from the midst of the sons of Israel that he may act as priest to me, Aaron, Naʹdab and A·biʹhu, El·e·aʹzar and Ithʹa·mar, the sons of Aaron.

2295.label: Exodus 28:2
2295.text: And you must make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and beauty.

2296.label: Exodus 28:3
2296.text: And you yourself are to speak to all the ones wise with a heart that I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, and they must make Aaron’s garments for sanctifying him, that he may act as priest to me.

2297.label: Exodus 28:4
2297.text: “And these are the garments that they will make: a breastpiece, and an ephʹod and a sleeveless coat and a robe of checkerwork, a turban and a sash; and they must make the holy garments for Aaron your brother and his sons, that he may act as priest to me.

2298.label: Exodus 28:5
2298.text: And they themselves will take the gold and the blue thread and the wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and the fine linen.

2299.label: Exodus 28:6
2299.text: “And they must make the ephʹod of gold, blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple, coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer.

2300.label: Exodus 28:7
2300.text: And it is to have two shoulder pieces to be joined at its two extremities, and it must be joined.

2301.label: Exodus 28:8
2301.text: And the girdle, which is upon it for tying it close, according to its workmanship should be of its materials, of gold, blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen.

2302.label: Exodus 28:9
2302.text: “And you must take two onyx stones and engrave upon them the names of the sons of Israel,

2303.label: Exodus 28:10
2303.text: six of their names upon the one stone and the names of the six remaining ones upon the other stone in the order of their births.

2304.label: Exodus 28:11
2304.text: With the work of a craftsman in stones, with the engravings of a seal, you are to engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Israel. Set in settings of gold is how you will make them.

2305.label: Exodus 28:12
2305.text: And you must put the two stones upon the shoulder pieces of the ephʹod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel; and Aaron must carry their names before Jehovah upon his two shoulder pieces as a memorial.

2306.label: Exodus 28:13
2306.text: And you must make settings of gold,

2307.label: Exodus 28:14
2307.text: and two chains of pure gold. As cords you will make them, with the workmanship of a rope; and you must attach the ropelike chains to the settings.

2308.label: Exodus 28:15
2308.text: “And you must make the breastpiece of judgment with the workmanship of an embroiderer. Like the workmanship of the ephʹod you will make it. Of gold, blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen you will make it.

2309.label: Exodus 28:16
2309.text: It should be foursquare when doubled, a span of the hand being its length and a span of the hand its width.

2310.label: Exodus 28:17
2310.text: And you must fill it with a filling of stones, there being four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz and emerald is the first row.

2311.label: Exodus 28:18
2311.text: And the second row is turquoise, sapphire and jasper.

2312.label: Exodus 28:19
2312.text: And the third row is leshʹem stone, agate and amethyst.

2313.label: Exodus 28:20
2313.text: And the fourth row is chrysʹo·lite and onyx and jade. Sockets of gold should be in their fillings.

2314.label: Exodus 28:21
2314.text: And the stones should be according to the names of the sons of Israel, the twelve according to their names. With the engravings of a seal they should be, each one according to its name, for the twelve tribes.

2315.label: Exodus 28:22
2315.text: “And you must make upon the breastpiece wreathed chains, in ropework, of pure gold.

2316.label: Exodus 28:23
2316.text: And you must make upon the breastpiece two rings of gold, and you must put the two rings upon the two extremities of the breastpiece.

2317.label: Exodus 28:24
2317.text: And you must put the two ropes of gold through the two rings at the extremities of the breastpiece.

2318.label: Exodus 28:25
2318.text: And you will put the two ends of the two ropes through the two settings, and you must put them upon the shoulder pieces of the ephʹod, at the forefront of it.

2319.label: Exodus 28:26
2319.text: And you must make two rings of gold and set them at the two extremities of the breastpiece upon its edge that is on the side toward the ephʹod inward.

2320.label: Exodus 28:27
2320.text: And you must make two rings of gold and put them upon the two shoulder pieces of the ephʹod from below, on its forefront, near its place of joining, above the girdle of the ephʹod.

2321.label: Exodus 28:28
2321.text: And they will bind the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephʹod with a blue string, that it may continue above the girdle of the ephʹod and the breastpiece may not get displaced from on top the ephʹod.

2322.label: Exodus 28:29
2322.text: “And Aaron must carry the names of the sons of Israel on the breastpiece of judgment over his heart when he comes into the Holy as a memorial before Jehovah constantly.

2323.label: Exodus 28:30
2323.text: And you must put the Uʹrim and the Thumʹmim into the breastpiece of judgment, and they must prove to be over Aaron’s heart when he comes in before Jehovah; and Aaron must carry the judgments of the sons of Israel over his heart before Jehovah constantly.

2324.label: Exodus 28:31
2324.text: “And you must make the sleeveless coat of the ephʹod completely of blue thread.

2325.label: Exodus 28:32
2325.text: And there must be an opening at its top in the middle of it. Its opening should have a border round about, the product of a loom worker. Like the opening of a coat of mail it should be for it, that it may not be torn.

2326.label: Exodus 28:33
2326.text: And you must make upon the hem of it pomegranates of blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material, upon its hem round about, and bells of gold in between them round about;

2327.label: Exodus 28:34
2327.text: a bell of gold and a pomegranate, a bell of gold and a pomegranate upon the hem of the sleeveless coat round about.

2328.label: Exodus 28:35
2328.text: And it must be upon Aaron that he may minister, and the sound from him must be heard when he goes into the sanctuary before Jehovah and when he comes out, that he may not die.

2329.label: Exodus 28:36
2329.text: “And you must make a shining plate of pure gold and engrave upon it with the engravings of a seal, ‘Holiness belongs to Jehovah.’

2330.label: Exodus 28:37
2330.text: And you must fasten it with a blue string, and it must come to be upon the turban. On the forefront of the turban it should come to be.

2331.label: Exodus 28:38
2331.text: And it must come to be upon Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron must answer for the error committed against the holy objects, which the sons of Israel will sanctify, that is to say, all their holy gifts; and it must stay upon his forehead constantly, to gain approval for them before Jehovah.

2332.label: Exodus 28:39
2332.text: “And you must weave in checkerwork the robe of fine linen and make a turban of fine linen, and you will make a sash, the work of a weaver.

2333.label: Exodus 28:40
2333.text: “And for Aaron’s sons you will make robes, and you must make sashes for them, and you will make headgears for them for glory and beauty.

2334.label: Exodus 28:41
2334.text: And with them you must clothe Aaron your brother and his sons with him, and you must anoint them and fill their hand with power and sanctify them, and they must act as priests to me.

2335.label: Exodus 28:42
2335.text: And make drawers of linen for them to cover the naked flesh. From the hips and to the thighs they are to extend.

2336.label: Exodus 28:43
2336.text: And they must be upon Aaron and his sons when they come into the tent of meeting or when they go near to the altar to minister in the holy place, that they may not incur error and certainly die. It is a statute to time indefinite for him and his offspring after him.

2337.label: Exodus 29:1
2337.text: “And this is the thing that you are to do to them to sanctify them for acting as priests to me: Take a young bull, and two rams, sound ones,

2338.label: Exodus 29:2
2338.text: and unfermented bread and unfermented ring-shaped cakes moistened with oil and unfermented wafers smeared with oil. Out of fine wheat flour you will make them.

2339.label: Exodus 29:3
2339.text: And you must put them upon a basket and present them in the basket, and also the bull and the two rams.

2340.label: Exodus 29:4
2340.text: “And you will present Aaron and his sons at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and you must wash them with water.

2341.label: Exodus 29:5
2341.text: Then you must take the garments and clothe Aaron with the robe and the sleeveless coat of the ephʹod and with the ephʹod and the breastpiece, and you must tie it closely to him with the girdle of the ephʹod.

2342.label: Exodus 29:6
2342.text: And you must set the turban upon his head and put the holy sign of dedication upon the turban.

2343.label: Exodus 29:7
2343.text: And you must take the anointing oil and pour it upon his head and anoint him.

2344.label: Exodus 29:8
2344.text: “Then you will bring his sons near and you must clothe them with the robes.

2345.label: Exodus 29:9
2345.text: And you must gird them with the sashes, Aaron as well as his sons, and you must wrap the headgear upon them; and the priesthood must become theirs as a statute to time indefinite. So you must fill the hand of Aaron and the hand of his sons with power.

2346.label: Exodus 29:10
2346.text: “You must now present the bull before the tent of meeting, and Aaron and his sons must lay their hands upon the bull’s head.

2347.label: Exodus 29:11
2347.text: And you must slaughter the bull before Jehovah, at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2348.label: Exodus 29:12
2348.text: And you must take some of the bull’s blood and put it with your finger upon the horns of the altar, and all the rest of the blood you will pour out at the base of the altar.

2349.label: Exodus 29:13
2349.text: And you must take all the fat that covers the intestines, and the appendage upon the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them, and you must make them smoke upon the altar.

2350.label: Exodus 29:14
2350.text: But the bull’s flesh and its skin and its dung you will burn with fire outside the camp. It is a sin offering.

2351.label: Exodus 29:15
2351.text: “Then you will take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons must lay their hands upon the ram’s head.

2352.label: Exodus 29:16
2352.text: And you must slaughter the ram and take its blood and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.

2353.label: Exodus 29:17
2353.text: And you will cut up the ram into its pieces, and you must wash its intestines and its shanks and put its pieces to one another and up to its head.

2354.label: Exodus 29:18
2354.text: And you must make the entire ram smoke upon the altar. It is a burnt offering to Jehovah, a restful odor. It is an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2355.label: Exodus 29:19
2355.text: “Next you must take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons must lay their hands upon the ram’s head.

2356.label: Exodus 29:20
2356.text: And you must slaughter the ram and take some of its blood and put it upon the lobe of Aaron’s right ear and upon the lobe of his sons’ right ear and upon the thumb of their right hand and the big toe of their right foot, and you must sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar.

2357.label: Exodus 29:21
2357.text: And you must take some of the blood that is upon the altar and some of the anointing oil, and you must spatter it upon Aaron and his garments and upon his sons and the garments of his sons with him, that he and his garments and his sons and the garments of his sons with him may indeed be holy.

2358.label: Exodus 29:22
2358.text: “And you must take from the ram the fat and the fat tail and the fat that covers the intestines, and the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that is upon them, and the right leg, for it is a ram of installation;

2359.label: Exodus 29:23
2359.text: also a round loaf of bread and a ring-shaped cake of oiled bread and a wafer out of the basket of unfermented cakes that is before Jehovah.

2360.label: Exodus 29:24
2360.text: And you must place them all upon the palms of Aaron and upon the palms of his sons, and you must wave them to and fro as a wave offering before Jehovah.

2361.label: Exodus 29:25
2361.text: And you must take them off their hands and make them smoke upon the altar upon the burnt offering as a restful odor before Jehovah. It is an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2362.label: Exodus 29:26
2362.text: “And you must take the breast of the ram of installation, which is for Aaron, and wave it to and fro as a wave offering before Jehovah, and it must become your portion.

2363.label: Exodus 29:27
2363.text: And you must sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the leg of the sacred portion that was waved and that was contributed from the ram of installation, from what was for Aaron and from what was for his sons.

2364.label: Exodus 29:28
2364.text: And it must become Aaron’s and his sons’ by a regulation to time indefinite to be performed by the sons of Israel, because it is a sacred portion; and it will become a sacred portion to be rendered by the sons of Israel. From their communion sacrifices it is their sacred portion for Jehovah.

2365.label: Exodus 29:29
2365.text: “And the holy garments that are Aaron’s will serve for his sons after him to anoint them in them and to fill their hand with power in them.

2366.label: Exodus 29:30
2366.text: Seven days the priest who succeeds him from among his sons and who comes into the tent of meeting to minister in the holy place will wear them.

2367.label: Exodus 29:31
2367.text: “And you will take the ram of installation, and you must boil its flesh in a holy place.

2368.label: Exodus 29:32
2368.text: And Aaron and his sons must eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that is in the basket at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2369.label: Exodus 29:33
2369.text: And they must eat the things with which atonement has been made to fill their hand with power, in order to sanctify them. But a stranger may not eat them, because they are something holy.

2370.label: Exodus 29:34
