2370.text: And if any of the flesh of the installation sacrifice and of the bread should be left over until the morning, then you must burn what is left over with fire. It must not be eaten, because it is something holy.

2371.label: Exodus 29:35
2371.text: “And you must do this way to Aaron and his sons according to all that I have commanded you. You will take seven days to fill their hand with power.

2372.label: Exodus 29:36
2372.text: And you will offer the bull of the sin offering daily for an atonement, and you must purify the altar from sin by your making atonement over it, and you must anoint it to sanctify it.

2373.label: Exodus 29:37
2373.text: You will take seven days to make atonement over the altar, and you must sanctify it that it may indeed become a most holy altar. Anyone who touches the altar is to be holy.

2374.label: Exodus 29:38
2374.text: “And this is what you will offer upon the altar: young rams each a year old, two a day constantly.

2375.label: Exodus 29:39
2375.text: And you will offer the one young ram in the morning, and you will offer the other young ram between the two evenings.

2376.label: Exodus 29:40
2376.text: And a tenth part of an eʹphah measure of fine flour moistened with the fourth of a hin of beaten oil, and a drink offering of the fourth of a hin of wine, will go for the first young ram.

2377.label: Exodus 29:41
2377.text: And you will offer the second young ram between the two evenings. With a grain offering like that of the morning and with a drink offering like its, you will render it as a restful odor, an offering made by fire to Jehovah.

2378.label: Exodus 29:42
2378.text: It is a constant burnt offering throughout YOUR generations at the entrance of the tent of meeting before Jehovah, where I shall present myself to YOU people to speak to you there.

2379.label: Exodus 29:43
2379.text: “And I will present myself there to the sons of Israel, and it will certainly be sanctified by my glory.

2380.label: Exodus 29:44
2380.text: And I will sanctify the tent of meeting and the altar; and I shall sanctify Aaron and his sons for them to act as priests to me.

2381.label: Exodus 29:45
2381.text: And I will tabernacle in the midst of the sons of Israel, and I will prove to be their God.

2382.label: Exodus 29:46
2382.text: And they will certainly know that I am Jehovah their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt that I may tabernacle in the midst of them. I am Jehovah their God.

2383.label: Exodus 30:1
2383.text: “And you must make an altar as a place for burning incense; out of acacia wood you will make it.

2384.label: Exodus 30:2
2384.text: A cubit in length and a cubit in width, it should be foursquare, and its height two cubits. Its horns extend out of it.

2385.label: Exodus 30:3
2385.text: And you must overlay it with pure gold, its top surface and its sides round about and its horns; and you must make a border of gold round about for it.

2386.label: Exodus 30:4
2386.text: You will also make for it two rings of gold. Down below its border upon two of its sides you will make them, upon two opposite sides of it, as they must serve as supports for the poles with which to carry it.

2387.label: Exodus 30:5
2387.text: And you must make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.

2388.label: Exodus 30:6
2388.text: And you must put it before the curtain that is near the ark of the testimony, before the cover that is over the Testimony, where I shall present myself to you.

2389.label: Exodus 30:7
2389.text: “And Aaron must make perfumed incense smoke upon it. Morning by morning, when he dresses the lamps, he will make it smoke.

2390.label: Exodus 30:8
2390.text: And when Aaron lights up the lamps between the two evenings, he will make it smoke. It is an incense constantly before Jehovah during YOUR generations.

2391.label: Exodus 30:9
2391.text: YOU must not offer upon it illegitimate incense or a burnt offering or a grain offering; and YOU must not pour a drink offering upon it.

2392.label: Exodus 30:10
2392.text: And Aaron must make atonement upon its horns once a year. With some of the blood of the sin offering of the atonement he will make atonement for it once a year during YOUR generations. It is most holy to Jehovah.”

2393.label: Exodus 30:11
2393.text: And Jehovah went on to speak to Moses, saying:

2394.label: Exodus 30:12
2394.text: “Whenever you take the sum of the sons of Israel as a census of them, then they must each give a ransom for his soul to Jehovah when taking a census of them, that there may come to be no plague upon them when taking a census of them.

2395.label: Exodus 30:13
2395.text: This is what all those will give who pass over to those numbered: a half shekel by the shekel of the holy place. Twenty geʹrahs equal a shekel. A half shekel is the contribution to Jehovah.

2396.label: Exodus 30:14
2396.text: Everyone passing over to those registered from twenty years old and upward will give Jehovah’s contribution.

2397.label: Exodus 30:15
2397.text: The rich should not give more, and the lowly must not give less than the half shekel, in order to give Jehovah’s contribution so as to make atonement for YOUR souls.

2398.label: Exodus 30:16
2398.text: And you must take the silver money of the atonement from the sons of Israel and give it in behalf of the service of the tent of meeting, that it may indeed serve as a memorial before Jehovah for the sons of Israel, to make atonement for YOUR souls.”

2399.label: Exodus 30:17
2399.text: And Jehovah spoke further to Moses, saying:

2400.label: Exodus 30:18
2400.text: “You must make a basin of copper and its stand of copper for washing, and you must put it between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water into it.

2401.label: Exodus 30:19
2401.text: And Aaron and his sons must wash their hands and their feet at it.

2402.label: Exodus 30:20
2402.text: When they go into the tent of meeting they will wash with water that they may not die, or when they go near the altar to minister in order to make an offering made by fire smoke to Jehovah.

2403.label: Exodus 30:21
2403.text: And they must wash their hands and their feet that they may not die, and it must serve as a regulation to time indefinite for them, for him and his offspring throughout their generations.”

2404.label: Exodus 30:22
2404.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

2405.label: Exodus 30:23
2405.text: “As for you, take to yourself the choicest perfumes: myrrh in congealed drops five hundred units, and sweet cinnamon in half that amount, two hundred and fifty units, and sweet calamus two hundred and fifty units,

2406.label: Exodus 30:24
2406.text: and cassia five hundred units by the shekel of the holy place, and olive oil a hin.

2407.label: Exodus 30:25
2407.text: Then you must make out of it a holy anointing oil, an ointment, a mixture that is the work of an ointment maker. It is to be a holy anointing oil.

2408.label: Exodus 30:26
2408.text: “And you must anoint with it the tent of meeting and the ark of the testimony,

2409.label: Exodus 30:27
2409.text: and the table and all its utensils and the lampstand and its utensils and the altar of incense,

2410.label: Exodus 30:28
2410.text: and the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils and the basin and its stand.

2411.label: Exodus 30:29
2411.text: And you must sanctify them that they may indeed become most holy. Anyone touching them is to be holy.

2412.label: Exodus 30:30
2412.text: And you will anoint Aaron and his sons, and you must sanctify them for acting as priests to me.

2413.label: Exodus 30:31
2413.text: “And you will speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘This is to continue as a holy anointing oil to me during YOUR generations.

2414.label: Exodus 30:32
2414.text: It is not to be rubbed in the flesh of mankind, and with its composition YOU must not make any like it. It is something holy. It is to continue as something holy for YOU.

2415.label: Exodus 30:33
2415.text: Anyone who makes an ointment like it and who puts some of it upon a stranger must be cut off from his people.’”

2416.label: Exodus 30:34
2416.text: And Jehovah went on to say to Moses: “Take to yourself perfumes: stacte drops and onycha and perfumed galbanum and pure frankincense. There should be the same portion of each.

2417.label: Exodus 30:35
2417.text: And you must make it into an incense, a spice mixture, the work of an ointment maker, salted, pure, something holy.

2418.label: Exodus 30:36
2418.text: And you must pound some of it into fine powder and put some of it before the Testimony in the tent of meeting, where I shall present myself to you. It should be most holy to YOU people.

2419.label: Exodus 30:37
2419.text: And the incense that you will make with this composition, YOU must not make for yourselves. For you it is to continue as something holy to Jehovah.

2420.label: Exodus 30:38
2420.text: Whoever makes any like it to enjoy its smell must be cut off from his people.”

2421.label: Exodus 31:1
2421.text: And Jehovah continued to speak to Moses, saying:

2422.label: Exodus 31:2
2422.text: “See, I do call by name Bezʹal·el the son of Uʹri the son of Hur of the tribe of Judah.

2423.label: Exodus 31:3
2423.text: And I shall fill him with the spirit of God in wisdom and in understanding and in knowledge and in every kind of craftsmanship,

2424.label: Exodus 31:4
2424.text: for designing devices, for working in gold and silver and copper,

2425.label: Exodus 31:5
2425.text: and in working of stones to set them and in working of wood to make products of every kind.

2426.label: Exodus 31:6
2426.text: As for me, look! I do put with him O·hoʹli·ab the son of A·hisʹa·mach of the tribe of Dan, and in the heart of everyone wise of heart I do put wisdom, that they may indeed make everything I have commanded you:

2427.label: Exodus 31:7
2427.text: the tent of meeting and the Ark for the testimony and the cover that is upon it, and all the utensils of the tent,

2428.label: Exodus 31:8
2428.text: and the table and its utensils, and the lampstand of pure gold and all its utensils, and the altar of incense,

2429.label: Exodus 31:9
2429.text: and the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin and its stand,

2430.label: Exodus 31:10
2430.text: and the garments of knitted work and the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for acting as priests;

2431.label: Exodus 31:11
2431.text: and the anointing oil and the perfumed incense for the sanctuary. According to everything I have commanded you they will do.”

2432.label: Exodus 31:12
2432.text: And Jehovah said further to Moses:

2433.label: Exodus 31:13
2433.text: “As for you, speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘Especially my sabbaths YOU are to keep, for it is a sign between me and YOU during YOUR generations that YOU may know that I Jehovah am sanctifying YOU.

2434.label: Exodus 31:14
2434.text: And YOU must keep the sabbath, for it is something holy to YOU. A profaner of it will positively be put to death. In case there is anyone doing work on it, then that soul must be cut off from the midst of his people.

2435.label: Exodus 31:15
2435.text: Six days may work be done, but on the seventh day is a sabbath of complete rest. It is something holy to Jehovah. Anyone doing work on the sabbath day will positively be put to death.

2436.label: Exodus 31:16
2436.text: And the sons of Israel must keep the sabbath, so as to carry out the sabbath during their generations. It is a covenant to time indefinite.

2437.label: Exodus 31:17
2437.text: Between me and the sons of Israel it is a sign to time indefinite, because in six days Jehovah made the heavens and the earth and on the seventh day he rested and proceeded to refresh himself.’”

2438.label: Exodus 31:18
2438.text: Now as soon as he had finished speaking with him on Mount Siʹnai he proceeded to give Moses two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone written on by God’s finger.

2439.label: Exodus 32:1
2439.text: Meanwhile the people got to see that Moses was taking a long time about coming down from the mountain. So the people congregated themselves about Aaron and said to him: “Get up, make for us a god who will go ahead of us, because as regards this Moses, the man who led us up out of the land of Egypt, we certainly do not know what has happened to him.”

2440.label: Exodus 32:2
2440.text: At this Aaron said to them: “Tear off the gold earrings that are in the ears of YOUR wives, of YOUR sons and of YOUR daughters and bring them to me.”

2441.label: Exodus 32:3
2441.text: And all the people began tearing off the gold earrings that were in their ears and bringing them to Aaron.

2442.label: Exodus 32:4
2442.text: Then he took [the gold] from their hands, and he formed it with a graving tool and proceeded to make it into a molten statue of a calf. And they began to say: “This is your God, O Israel, who led you up out of the land of Egypt.”

2443.label: Exodus 32:5
2443.text: When Aaron got to see this, he went to building an altar before it. Finally Aaron called out and said: “There is a festival to Jehovah tomorrow.”

2444.label: Exodus 32:6
2444.text: So on the next day they were early in rising, and they began offering up burnt offerings and presenting communion sacrifices. After that the people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to have a good time.

2445.label: Exodus 32:7
2445.text: Jehovah now said to Moses: “Go, descend, because your people whom you led up out of the land of Egypt have acted ruinously.

2446.label: Exodus 32:8
2446.text: They have turned aside in a hurry from the way I have commanded them to go. They have made a molten statue of a calf for themselves and keep bowing down to it and sacrificing to it and saying, ‘This is your God, O Israel, who led you up out of the land of Egypt.’”

2447.label: Exodus 32:9
2447.text: And Jehovah went on to say to Moses: “I have looked at this people and here it is a stiff-necked people.

2448.label: Exodus 32:10
2448.text: So now let me be, that my anger may blaze against them and I may exterminate them, and let me make you into a great nation.”

2449.label: Exodus 32:11
2449.text: And Moses proceeded to soften the face of Jehovah his God and to say: “Why, O Jehovah, should your anger blaze against your people whom you brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a strong hand?

2450.label: Exodus 32:12
2450.text: Why should the Egyptians say, ‘With evil intent he brought them out in order to kill them among the mountains and to exterminate them from the surface of the ground’? Turn from your burning anger and feel regret over the evil against your people.

2451.label: Exodus 32:13
2451.text: Remember Abraham, Isaac and Israel your servants, to whom you swore by yourself, in that you said to them, ‘I shall multiply YOUR seed like the stars of the heavens, and all this land that I have designated I shall give to YOUR seed, that they may indeed take possession of it to time indefinite.’”

2452.label: Exodus 32:14
2452.text: And Jehovah began to feel regret over the evil that he had spoken of doing to his people.

2453.label: Exodus 32:15
2453.text: After that Moses turned and went down from the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hand, tablets written upon on both their sides. On this side and on that they were written upon.

2454.label: Exodus 32:16
2454.text: And the tablets were the workmanship of God, and the writing was the writing of God engraved upon the tablets.

2455.label: Exodus 32:17
2455.text: And Joshua began to hear the noise of the people because of their shouting, and he proceeded to say to Moses: “There is a noise of battle in the camp.”

2456.label: Exodus 32:18
2456.text: But he said: “It is not the sound of the singing over mighty performance, And it is not the sound of the singing of defeat;It is the sound of other singing that I am hearing.”

2457.label: Exodus 32:19
2457.text: So it came about that as soon as he got near the camp and could see the calf and the dances, Moses’ anger began to blaze, and he at once threw the tablets from his hands and shattered them at the foot of the mountain.

2458.label: Exodus 32:20
2458.text: Then he took the calf that they had made and he burnt it with fire and crushed it till it was fine, after which he scattered it upon the surface of the waters and made the sons of Israel drink it.

2459.label: Exodus 32:21
2459.text: After that Moses said to Aaron: “What did this people do to you that you have brought a great sin upon it?”

2460.label: Exodus 32:22
2460.text: To this Aaron said: “Do not let the anger of my lord blaze. You yourself well know the people, that they are evil-inclined.

2461.label: Exodus 32:23
2461.text: So they said to me, ‘Make for us a god who will go ahead of us, because as regards this Moses, the man who led us up out of the land of Egypt, we certainly do not know what has happened to him.’

2462.label: Exodus 32:24
2462.text: Hence I said to them, ‘Who have any gold? They must tear it off themselves that they may give it to me.’ And I proceeded to throw it into the fire and this calf came on out.”

2463.label: Exodus 32:25
2463.text: And Moses got to see that the people went unrestrained, because Aaron had let them go unrestrained for a disgrace among their opposers.

2464.label: Exodus 32:26
2464.text: Then Moses took his stand in the gate of the camp and said: “Who is on Jehovah’s side? To me!” And all the sons of Leʹvi began gathering themselves to him.

2465.label: Exodus 32:27
2465.text: He now said to them: “This is what Jehovah the God of Israel has said, ‘Put each one of YOU his sword on his side. Pass through and return from gate to gate in the camp and kill each one his brother and each one his fellow and each one his intimate acquaintance.’”

2466.label: Exodus 32:28
2466.text: And the sons of Leʹvi proceeded to do as Moses had said, so that there fell of the people on that day about three thousand men.

2467.label: Exodus 32:29
2467.text: And Moses went on to say: “Fill YOUR hand today with power for Jehovah, because each one of YOU is against his own son and his own brother, and that he may confer a blessing upon YOU today.”

2468.label: Exodus 32:30
2468.text: And it came about on the very next day that Moses proceeded to say to the people: “YOU—YOU have sinned with a great sin, and now I shall go up to Jehovah. Perhaps I can make amends for YOUR sin.”

2469.label: Exodus 32:31
2469.text: So Moses returned to Jehovah and said: “Ah, but this people has sinned with a great sin, in that they made a god of gold for themselves!

2470.label: Exodus 32:32
2470.text: But now if you will pardon their sin, —and if not, wipe me out, please, from your book that you have written.”

2471.label: Exodus 32:33
2471.text: However, Jehovah said to Moses: “Whoever has sinned against me, I shall wipe him out of my book.

2472.label: Exodus 32:34
2472.text: And now, come, lead the people to where I have spoken to you of. Look! My angel will go ahead of you, and on the day of my bringing punishment I shall certainly bring punishment upon them for their sin.”

2473.label: Exodus 32:35
2473.text: And Jehovah began plaguing the people because they had made the calf, which Aaron had made.

2474.label: Exodus 33:1
2474.text: And Jehovah said further to Moses: “Go, move up from here, you and the people whom you led up out of the land of Egypt, to the land about which I swore to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, saying, ‘To your seed I shall give it.’

2475.label: Exodus 33:2
2475.text: And I will send an angel ahead of you and drive out the Caʹnaan·ites, the Amʹor·ites, and the Hitʹtites and the Perʹiz·zites, the Hiʹvites and the Jebʹu·sites;

2476.label: Exodus 33:3
2476.text: to a land flowing with milk and honey, for I shall not go up in the midst of you, because you are a stiff-necked people, that I may not exterminate you on the way.”

2477.label: Exodus 33:4
2477.text: When the people got to hear this evil word, they began to mourn; and none of them put his ornaments on himself.

2478.label: Exodus 33:5
2478.text: And Jehovah went on to say to Moses: “Say to the sons of Israel, ‘YOU are a stiff-necked people. In one moment I could go up into the midst of you and certainly exterminate you. So now put down your ornaments off yourself, as I want to know what I am going to do to you.’”

2479.label: Exodus 33:6
2479.text: And the sons of Israel went stripping their ornaments off themselves from Mount Hoʹreb onward.

2480.label: Exodus 33:7
2480.text: As for Moses, he proceeded to take his tent away and he pitched it outside the camp, far away from the camp; and he called it a tent of meeting. And it occurred that everyone inquiring of Jehovah would go out to the tent of meeting, which was outside the camp.

2481.label: Exodus 33:8
2481.text: And it occurred that as soon as Moses went out to the tent, all the people would rise, and they stationed themselves each one at the entrance of his own tent, and they gazed after Moses until he went into the tent.

2482.label: Exodus 33:9
2482.text: It also occurred that as soon as Moses had gone into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down, and it stood at the entrance of the tent and he spoke with Moses.

2483.label: Exodus 33:10
2483.text: And all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance of the tent, and all the people rose and bowed down each one at the entrance of his own tent.

2484.label: Exodus 33:11
2484.text: And Jehovah spoke to Moses face to face, just as a man would speak to his fellow. When he returned to the camp, his minister Joshua, the son of Nun, as attendant, would not withdraw from the midst of the tent.

2485.label: Exodus 33:12
2485.text: Now Moses said to Jehovah: “See, you are saying to me, ‘Lead this people up,’ but you yourself have not let me know whom you will send with me. Moreover, you yourself have said, ‘I do know you by name and, besides, you have found favor in my eyes.’

2486.label: Exodus 33:13
2486.text: And now, if, please, I have found favor in your eyes, make me know, please, your ways, that I may know you, in order that I may find favor in your eyes. And consider that this nation is your people.”

2487.label: Exodus 33:14
2487.text: So he said: “My own person will go along and I shall certainly give you rest.”

2488.label: Exodus 33:15
2488.text: At this he said to him: “If your own person is not going along, do not lead us up from here.

2489.label: Exodus 33:16
2489.text: And by what, now, will it be known that I have found favor in your eyes, I and your people? Is it not by your going along with us, in that I and your people have been made distinct from all the other people who are upon the surface of the ground?”

2490.label: Exodus 33:17
2490.text: And Jehovah went on to say to Moses: “This thing, too, of which you have spoken, I shall do, because you have found favor in my eyes and I know you by name.”

2491.label: Exodus 33:18
2491.text: At this he said: “Cause me to see, please, your glory.”

2492.label: Exodus 33:19
2492.text: But he said: “I myself shall cause all my goodness to pass before your face, and I will declare the name of Jehovah before you; and I will favor the one whom I may favor, and I will show mercy to the one to whom I may show mercy.”

2493.label: Exodus 33:20
2493.text: And he added: “You are not able to see my face, because no man may see me and yet live.”

2494.label: Exodus 33:21
2494.text: And Jehovah said further: “Here is a place with me, and you must station yourself upon the rock.

2495.label: Exodus 33:22
2495.text: And it has to occur that while my glory is passing by I must place you in a hole in the rock, and I must put my palm over you as a screen until I have passed by.

2496.label: Exodus 33:23
2496.text: After that I must take my palm away, and you will indeed see my back. But my face may not be seen.”

2497.label: Exodus 34:1
2497.text: Then Jehovah said to Moses: “Carve out for yourself two tablets of stone like the first ones, and I must write upon the tablets the words that appeared on the first tablets, which you shattered.

2498.label: Exodus 34:2
2498.text: And get ready for the morning, as you must go up in the morning into Mount Siʹnai and station yourself by me there on the top of the mountain.

2499.label: Exodus 34:3
2499.text: But nobody may go up with you and, too, let nobody else be seen in all the mountain. What is more, no flock or herd should be pasturing in front of that mountain.”

2500.label: Exodus 34:4
2500.text: Accordingly Moses carved out two tablets of stone like the first ones and got up early in the morning and went on up into Mount Siʹnai, just as Jehovah had commanded him, and he was taking the two tablets of stone in his hand.

2501.label: Exodus 34:5
2501.text: And Jehovah proceeded to come down in the cloud and station himself with him there and declare the name of Jehovah.

2502.label: Exodus 34:6
2502.text: And Jehovah went passing by before his face and declaring: “Jehovah, Jehovah, a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abundant in loving-kindness and truth,

2503.label: Exodus 34:7
2503.text: preserving loving-kindness for thousands, pardoning error and transgression and sin, but by no means will he give exemption from punishment, bringing punishment for the error of fathers upon sons and upon grandsons, upon the third generation and upon the fourth generation.”

2504.label: Exodus 34:8
2504.text: Moses at once hurried to bow low to the earth and prostrate himself.

2505.label: Exodus 34:9
2505.text: Then he said: “If, now, I have found favor in your eyes, O Jehovah, let Jehovah, please, go along in the midst of us, because it is a stiff-necked people, and you have to forgive our error and our sin, and you must take us as your possession.”

2506.label: Exodus 34:10
2506.text: In turn he said: “Here I am concluding a covenant: Before all your people I shall do wonderful things that have never been created in all the earth or among all the nations; and all the people in the midst of whom you are will indeed see the work of Jehovah, because it is a fear-inspiring thing that I am doing with you.

2507.label: Exodus 34:11
2507.text: “For your part keep what I am commanding you today. Here I am driving out from before you the Amʹor·ites and the Caʹnaan·ites and the Hitʹtites and the Perʹiz·zites and the Hiʹvites and the Jebʹu·sites.

2508.label: Exodus 34:12
2508.text: Watch yourself that you do not conclude a covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which you are going, for fear it may prove itself a snare in your midst.

2509.label: Exodus 34:13
2509.text: But their altars YOU people are to pull down, and their sacred pillars YOU are to shatter, and their sacred poles YOU are to cut down.

2510.label: Exodus 34:14
2510.text: For you must not prostrate yourself to another god, because Jehovah, whose name is Jealous, he is a jealous God;

2511.label: Exodus 34:15
2511.text: for fear that you may conclude a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, as they will certainly have immoral intercourse with their gods and sacrifice to their gods, and someone will be certain to invite you, and you will certainly eat some of his sacrifice.

2512.label: Exodus 34:16
2512.text: Then you will have to take some of their daughters for your sons, and their daughters will be certain to have immoral intercourse with their gods and make your sons have immoral intercourse with their gods.

2513.label: Exodus 34:17
2513.text: “You must not make molten idol gods for yourself.

2514.label: Exodus 34:18
2514.text: “The festival of unfermented cakes you are to keep. You will eat unfermented cakes, just as I have commanded you, seven days at the appointed time in the month of Aʹbib, because it was in the month of Aʹbib that you came out of Egypt.

2515.label: Exodus 34:19
2515.text: “Everything that first opens the womb is mine, and, as regards all your livestock, the male firstling of bull and of sheep.

2516.label: Exodus 34:20
2516.text: And the firstling of an ass you are to redeem with a sheep. But if you will not redeem it, then you must break its neck. Every firstborn of your sons you are to redeem. And they must not appear before me empty-handed.

2517.label: Exodus 34:21
2517.text: “Six days you are to labor, but on the seventh day you will keep sabbath. In plowing time and in harvest you will keep sabbath.

2518.label: Exodus 34:22
2518.text: “And you will carry on your festival of weeks with the first ripe fruits of the wheat harvest, and the festival of ingathering at the turn of the year.

2519.label: Exodus 34:23
2519.text: “Three times in the year every male of yours is to appear before the [true] Lord, Jehovah, the God of Israel.

2520.label: Exodus 34:24
2520.text: For I shall drive the nations away from before you, and I will make your territory spacious; and nobody will desire your land while you are going up to see the face of Jehovah your God three times in the year.

2521.label: Exodus 34:25
2521.text: “You must not slaughter along with what is leavened the blood of my sacrifice. And the sacrifice of the festival of the passover should not stay overnight until the morning.

2522.label: Exodus 34:26
2522.text: “The best of the first ripe fruits of your soil you are to bring to the house of Jehovah your God. “You must not boil a kid in its mother’s milk.”

2523.label: Exodus 34:27
2523.text: And Jehovah went on to say to Moses: “Write down for yourself these words, because it is in accordance with these words that I do conclude a covenant with you and Israel.”

2524.label: Exodus 34:28
2524.text: And he continued there with Jehovah forty days and forty nights. He ate no bread and he drank no water. And he proceeded to write upon the tablets the words of the covenant, the Ten Words.

2525.label: Exodus 34:29
2525.text: Now it came about when Moses came down from Mount Siʹnai that the two tablets of the Testimony were in the hand of Moses when he came down from the mountain, and Moses did not know that the skin of his face emitted rays because of his having spoken with him.

2526.label: Exodus 34:30
2526.text: When Aaron and all the sons of Israel got to see Moses, why, look! the skin of his face emitted rays and they grew afraid of coming near to him.

2527.label: Exodus 34:31
2527.text: And Moses proceeded to call them. So Aaron and all the chieftains among the assembly came back to him, and Moses began to speak to them.

2528.label: Exodus 34:32
2528.text: First after that all the sons of Israel came near to him, and he began commanding them all that Jehovah had spoken with him on Mount Siʹnai.

2529.label: Exodus 34:33
2529.text: When Moses would finish speaking with them, he would put a veil over his face.

2530.label: Exodus 34:34
2530.text: But when Moses would go in before Jehovah to speak with him, he would take away the veil until his going out. And he went out and spoke to the sons of Israel what he would be commanded.

2531.label: Exodus 34:35
2531.text: And the sons of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face emitted rays; and Moses put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with him.

2532.label: Exodus 35:1
2532.text: Later Moses called the entire assembly of the sons of Israel together and said to them: “These are the words that Jehovah has commanded, to do them:

2533.label: Exodus 35:2
2533.text: Six days may work be done, but on the seventh day it will become something holy to YOU, a sabbath of complete rest to Jehovah. Anybody doing work on it will be put to death.

2534.label: Exodus 35:3
2534.text: YOU must not light a fire in any of YOUR dwelling places on the sabbath day.”

2535.label: Exodus 35:4
2535.text: And Moses went on to say to the entire assembly of the sons of Israel: “This is the word that Jehovah has commanded, saying,

2536.label: Exodus 35:5
2536.text: ‘From among yourselves take up a contribution for Jehovah. Let every willing-hearted one bring it as Jehovah’s contribution, namely, gold and silver and copper

2537.label: Exodus 35:6
2537.text: and blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine linen and goat’s hair

2538.label: Exodus 35:7
2538.text: and ram skins dyed red and sealskins and acacia wood

2539.label: Exodus 35:8
2539.text: and oil for the luminary and balsam oil for the anointing oil and for the perfumed incense

2540.label: Exodus 35:9
2540.text: and onyx stones and setting stones for the ephʹod and for the breastpiece.

2541.label: Exodus 35:10
2541.text: “‘And let all the wise-hearted ones among YOU come and make all that Jehovah has commanded,

2542.label: Exodus 35:11
2542.text: namely, the tabernacle with its tent and its covering, its hooks and its panel frames, its bars, its pillars and its socket pedestals;

2543.label: Exodus 35:12
2543.text: the Ark and its poles, the cover and the curtain of the screen;

2544.label: Exodus 35:13
2544.text: the table and its poles and all its utensils and the showbread;

2545.label: Exodus 35:14
2545.text: and the lampstand of illumination and its utensils and its lamps and the oil for illumination;

2546.label: Exodus 35:15
2546.text: and the altar of incense and its poles; and the anointing oil and the perfumed incense; and the screen of the entrance for the tabernacle’s entrance;

2547.label: Exodus 35:16
2547.text: the altar of burnt offering and the copper grating that is for it, its poles and all its utensils; the basin and its stand;

2548.label: Exodus 35:17
2548.text: the hangings of the courtyard, its pillars and its socket pedestals; and the screen of the gate of the courtyard;

2549.label: Exodus 35:18
2549.text: the tent pins of the tabernacle and the tent pins of the courtyard and their cords;

2550.label: Exodus 35:19
2550.text: the garments of knitted work for ministering in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for acting as priests.’”

2551.label: Exodus 35:20
2551.text: Accordingly all the assembly of the sons of Israel went out from before Moses.

2552.label: Exodus 35:21
2552.text: Then they came, everyone whose heart impelled him, and they brought, everyone whose spirit incited him, Jehovah’s contribution for the work of the tent of meeting and for all its service and for the holy garments.

2553.label: Exodus 35:22
2553.text: And they kept coming, the men along with the women, every willing-hearted one. They brought brooches and earrings and rings and female ornaments, all sorts of articles of gold, that is, everyone who presented the wave offering of gold to Jehovah.

2554.label: Exodus 35:23
2554.text: And all those with whom there were found blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine linen and goat’s hair and ram skins dyed red and sealskins, brought them.

2555.label: Exodus 35:24
2555.text: All those contributing the contribution of silver and copper brought Jehovah’s contribution, and all those with whom there was found acacia wood for all the work of the service brought it.

2556.label: Exodus 35:25
2556.text: And all the women who were wise of heart spun with their hands, and they kept bringing as yarn the blue thread and the wool dyed reddish purple, the coccus scarlet material and the fine linen.

2557.label: Exodus 35:26
2557.text: And all the women whose hearts impelled them with wisdom spun the goat’s hair.

2558.label: Exodus 35:27
2558.text: And the chieftains brought onyx stones and setting stones for the ephʹod and the breastpiece,

2559.label: Exodus 35:28
2559.text: and the balsam oil and the oil for illumination and for the anointing oil and for the perfumed incense.

2560.label: Exodus 35:29
2560.text: Every man and woman whose hearts incited them to bring something for all the work that Jehovah had commanded to make by means of Moses did so; the sons of Israel brought a voluntary offering to Jehovah.

2561.label: Exodus 35:30
2561.text: Then Moses said to the sons of Israel: “See, Jehovah has called by name Bezʹal·el the son of Uʹri the son of Hur of the tribe of Judah.

2562.label: Exodus 35:31
2562.text: And he proceeded to fill him with the spirit of God in wisdom, in understanding and in knowledge and in every sort of craftsmanship

2563.label: Exodus 35:32
2563.text: and for designing devices, for working in gold and silver and copper,

2564.label: Exodus 35:33
2564.text: and in working of stones to set them and in working of wood to make ingenious products of every sort.

2565.label: Exodus 35:34
2565.text: And he has put it into his heart that he should teach, he and O·hoʹli·ab the son of A·hisʹa·mach of the tribe of Dan.

2566.label: Exodus 35:35
2566.text: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to do all the work of a craftsman and an embroiderer and of a weaver in blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple, in coccus scarlet material and fine linen, and of a loom worker, men doing every sort of work and designing devices.

2567.label: Exodus 36:1
2567.text: “And Bezʹal·el must work, also O·hoʹli·ab and every wise-hearted man to whom Jehovah has given wisdom and understanding in these things in order to know how to do all the work of the holy service according to all that Jehovah has commanded.”

2568.label: Exodus 36:2
2568.text: And Moses proceeded to call Bezʹal·el and O·hoʹli·ab and every wise-hearted man into whose heart Jehovah had put wisdom, everyone whose heart impelled him to approach the work in order to do it.

2569.label: Exodus 36:3
2569.text: Then they took from before Moses all the contribution that the sons of Israel had brought for the work of the holy service so as to do it, and, as for the latter, they still brought to him a voluntary offering morning after morning.

2570.label: Exodus 36:4
2570.text: And all the wise ones who were doing all the holy work began to come, one man after another, from their work that they were doing,

2571.label: Exodus 36:5
2571.text: and to say to Moses: “The people are bringing much more than what the service needs for the work that Jehovah has commanded to be done.”

2572.label: Exodus 36:6
2572.text: So Moses commanded that they should cause an announcement to pass through the camp, saying: “Men and women, do not produce any more stuff for the holy contribution.” With that the people were restrained from bringing it in.

2573.label: Exodus 36:7
2573.text: And the stuff proved to be enough for all the work to be done, and more than enough.

2574.label: Exodus 36:8
2574.text: And all the wise-hearted among those doing the work went making the tabernacle, the ten tent cloths of fine twisted linen and blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material; with cherubs, the work of an embroiderer, he made them.

2575.label: Exodus 36:9
2575.text: The length of each tent cloth was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each tent cloth four cubits. There was one measure for all the tent cloths.

2576.label: Exodus 36:10
2576.text: Then he joined five tent cloths one to another, and the five other tent cloths he joined one to another.

2577.label: Exodus 36:11
2577.text: After that he made loops of blue thread upon the edge of the one tent cloth at the junction end. He did the same on the edge of the outermost tent cloth at the other place of junction.

2578.label: Exodus 36:12
2578.text: He made fifty loops on the one tent cloth, and he made fifty loops on the extremity of the tent cloth that was at the other place of junction, the loops being opposite one another.

2579.label: Exodus 36:13
2579.text: Finally he made fifty hooks of gold and joined the tent cloths to one another by the hooks, so that it became one tabernacle.

2580.label: Exodus 36:14
2580.text: And he went on to make tent cloths of goat’s hair for the tent upon the tabernacle. Eleven tent cloths were what he made.

2581.label: Exodus 36:15
2581.text: The length of each tent cloth was thirty cubits, and the width of each tent cloth four cubits. There was one measure for the eleven tent cloths.

2582.label: Exodus 36:16
2582.text: Then he joined five tent cloths together by themselves and the six other tent cloths by themselves.

2583.label: Exodus 36:17
2583.text: Next he made fifty loops upon the edge of the outermost tent cloth at the place of junction, and he made fifty loops upon the edge of the other tent cloth that joined with it.

2584.label: Exodus 36:18
2584.text: After that he made fifty hooks of copper for joining the tent together to become one piece.

2585.label: Exodus 36:19
2585.text: And he proceeded to make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red and a covering out of sealskins up on top.

2586.label: Exodus 36:20
2586.text: Then he made the panel frames for the tabernacle out of acacia wood, standing on end.

2587.label: Exodus 36:21
2587.text: Ten cubits was the length of a panel frame, and one cubit and a half the width of each panel frame.

2588.label: Exodus 36:22
2588.text: Each panel frame had two tenons fitted one to the other. That is the way he did to all the panel frames of the tabernacle.

2589.label: Exodus 36:23
2589.text: So he made the panel frames for the tabernacle, twenty panel frames for the side toward the Negʹeb, to the south.

2590.label: Exodus 36:24
2590.text: And he made forty socket pedestals of silver for beneath the twenty panel frames, two socket pedestals beneath the one panel frame with its two tenons and two socket pedestals beneath the other panel frame with its two tenons.

2591.label: Exodus 36:25
2591.text: And for the other side of the tabernacle, the northern side, he made twenty panel frames

2592.label: Exodus 36:26
2592.text: and their forty socket pedestals of silver, two socket pedestals beneath the one panel frame and two socket pedestals beneath the other panel frame.

2593.label: Exodus 36:27
2593.text: And for the rear sections of the tabernacle to the west he made six panel frames.

2594.label: Exodus 36:28
2594.text: And he made two panel frames as corner posts of the tabernacle on its two rear sections.

2595.label: Exodus 36:29
2595.text: And they proved to be duplicates at the bottom and together they came to be twins to the top of each one at the first ring. That is what he did to them both, to the two corner posts.

2596.label: Exodus 36:30
2596.text: So they amounted to eight panel frames and their socket pedestals of silver to sixteen, two socket pedestals next to two socket pedestals beneath each panel frame.

2597.label: Exodus 36:31
2597.text: And he went on to make bars of acacia wood, five for the panel frames of the one side of the tabernacle

2598.label: Exodus 36:32
2598.text: and five bars for the panel frames of the other side of the tabernacle and five bars for the panel frames of the tabernacle for the two rear sections to the west.

2599.label: Exodus 36:33
2599.text: Then he made the middle bar to run through at the middle of the panel frames from one end to the other.

2600.label: Exodus 36:34
2600.text: And he overlaid the panel frames with gold, and he made their rings of gold as supports for the bars, and he went on to overlay the bars with gold.

2601.label: Exodus 36:35
2601.text: And he proceeded to make a curtain of blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen. With the work of an embroiderer he made it with cherubs.

2602.label: Exodus 36:36
2602.text: Then he made for it four acacia pillars and overlaid them with gold, their pegs being of gold, and cast four socket pedestals of silver for them.

2603.label: Exodus 36:37
2603.text: And he went on to make a screen for the entrance of the tent out of blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen, the work of a weaver,

2604.label: Exodus 36:38
2604.text: and its five pillars and their pegs. And he overlaid their tops and their joints with gold, but their five socket pedestals were of copper.

2605.label: Exodus 37:1
2605.text: Bezʹal·el now made the Ark of acacia wood. Two cubits and a half was its length, and a cubit and a half its width, and a cubit and a half its height.

2606.label: Exodus 37:2
2606.text: Then he overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside and made a border of gold round about for it.

2607.label: Exodus 37:3
2607.text: After that he cast four rings of gold for it, for above its four feet, with two rings on its one side and two rings on its other side.

2608.label: Exodus 37:4
2608.text: He next made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

2609.label: Exodus 37:5
2609.text: Then he put the poles through the rings on the sides of the Ark for carrying the Ark.

2610.label: Exodus 37:6
2610.text: And he went on to make the cover of pure gold. Two cubits and a half was its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

2611.label: Exodus 37:7
2611.text: He further made two cherubs of gold. Of hammered work he made them on both ends of the cover.

2612.label: Exodus 37:8
2612.text: One cherub was on the end over there, and the other cherub on the end over here. He made the cherubs on the cover on both of its ends.

2613.label: Exodus 37:9
2613.text: And they came to be cherubs spreading out two wings upward, screening over the cover with their wings, and their faces were one to the other. The faces of the cherubs proved to be toward the cover.

2614.label: Exodus 37:10
2614.text: And he proceeded to make the table of acacia wood. Two cubits was its length, and a cubit its width, and a cubit and a half its height.

2615.label: Exodus 37:11
2615.text: Then he overlaid it with pure gold and made a border of gold round about for it.

2616.label: Exodus 37:12
2616.text: Next he made for it a rim of a handbreadth round about and made a border of gold for its rim round about.

2617.label: Exodus 37:13
2617.text: Further, he cast four rings of gold for it and put the rings upon the four corners that were for the four feet.

2618.label: Exodus 37:14
2618.text: The rings proved to be near the rim, as supports for the poles for carrying the table.

2619.label: Exodus 37:15
2619.text: Then he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold for carrying the table.

2620.label: Exodus 37:16
2620.text: After that he made the utensils that are upon the table, its dishes and its cups and its bowls and its pitchers with which [libations] would be poured, out of pure gold.

2621.label: Exodus 37:17
2621.text: Then he made the lampstand of pure gold. Of hammered work he made the lampstand. Its sides and its branches, its cups, its knobs and its blossoms proceeded out of it.

2622.label: Exodus 37:18
2622.text: And six branches were running out from its sides, three branches of the lampstand out from its one side and three branches of the lampstand out from its other side.

2623.label: Exodus 37:19
2623.text: Three cups shaped like flowers of almond were on the one set of branches, with knobs and blossoms alternating; and three cups shaped like flowers of almond were on the other set of branches, with knobs and blossoms alternating. That is the way it was for the six branches running out from the lampstand.

2624.label: Exodus 37:20
2624.text: And on the lampstand there were four cups shaped like flowers of almond, with its knobs and its blossoms alternating.

2625.label: Exodus 37:21
2625.text: And the knob under two branches was out of it, and the knob under two other branches was out of it, and the knob under two more branches was out of it, for the six branches running out from the lampstand.

2626.label: Exodus 37:22
2626.text: Their knobs and their branches proceeded out from it. All of it was one piece of hammered work, of pure gold.

2627.label: Exodus 37:23
2627.text: Then he made its seven lamps and its snuffers and its fire holders out of pure gold.

2628.label: Exodus 37:24
2628.text: Of a talent of pure gold he made it and all its utensils.

2629.label: Exodus 37:25
2629.text: He now made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. A cubit was its length and a cubit its width, it being foursquare, and two cubits was its height. Its horns proceeded out of it.

2630.label: Exodus 37:26
2630.text: Then he overlaid it with pure gold, its top surface and its sides round about and its horns, and he made a border of gold round about for it.

2631.label: Exodus 37:27
2631.text: And he made for it two rings of gold down below its border upon two of its sides, upon two opposite sides of it, as supports for the poles with which to carry it.

2632.label: Exodus 37:28
2632.text: After that he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

2633.label: Exodus 37:29
2633.text: He made additionally the holy anointing oil and the pure, perfumed incense, the work of an ointment maker.

2634.label: Exodus 38:1
2634.text: And he went on to make the altar of burnt offering out of acacia wood. Five cubits was its length, and five cubits its width, it being foursquare, and three cubits was its height.

2635.label: Exodus 38:2
2635.text: Then he made its horns upon its four corners. Its horns proceeded out of it. Next he overlaid it with copper.

2636.label: Exodus 38:3
2636.text: After that he made all the utensils of the altar, the cans and the shovels and the bowls, the forks and the fire holders. All its utensils he made of copper.

2637.label: Exodus 38:4
2637.text: He further made for the altar a grating, a network of copper, under its rim, down toward its center.

2638.label: Exodus 38:5
2638.text: Then he cast four rings on the four extremities near the grating of copper, as supports for the poles.

2639.label: Exodus 38:6
2639.text: After that he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with copper.

2640.label: Exodus 38:7
2640.text: Then he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar for carrying it with them. He made it a hollow chest of planks.

2641.label: Exodus 38:8
2641.text: Then he made the basin of copper and its stand of copper, by the use of the mirrors of the women servants who did organized service at the entrance of the tent of meeting.

2642.label: Exodus 38:9
2642.text: And he proceeded to make the courtyard. For the side toward the Negʹeb, to the south, the hangings of the courtyard were of fine twisted linen, for a hundred cubits.

2643.label: Exodus 38:10
2643.text: Their twenty pillars and their twenty socket pedestals were of copper. The pegs of the pillars and their joints were of silver.

2644.label: Exodus 38:11
2644.text: Also, for the north side there were a hundred cubits. Their twenty pillars and their twenty socket pedestals were of copper. The pegs of the pillars and their joints were of silver.

2645.label: Exodus 38:12
2645.text: But for the west side the hangings were for fifty cubits. Their pillars were ten and their socket pedestals ten. The pegs of the pillars and their joints were of silver.

2646.label: Exodus 38:13
2646.text: And for the east side toward the sunrising there were fifty cubits.

2647.label: Exodus 38:14
2647.text: The hangings were for fifteen cubits to the one wing. Their pillars were three and their socket pedestals three.

2648.label: Exodus 38:15
2648.text: And for the other wing, on this as well as that side, of the gate of the courtyard, the hangings were for fifteen cubits. Their pillars were three and their socket pedestals three.

2649.label: Exodus 38:16
2649.text: All the hangings of the courtyard round about were of fine twisted linen.

2650.label: Exodus 38:17
2650.text: And the socket pedestals for the pillars were of copper. The pegs of the pillars and their joints were of silver and the overlaying of their tops was of silver, and there were silver joinings for all the pillars of the courtyard.

2651.label: Exodus 38:18
2651.text: And the screen of the gate of the courtyard was the work of a weaver, of blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen, and twenty cubits was the length, and the height throughout its extent was five cubits equally with the hangings of the courtyard.

2652.label: Exodus 38:19
2652.text: And their four pillars and their four socket pedestals were of copper. Their pegs were of silver and the overlaying of their heads and their joints were of silver.

2653.label: Exodus 38:20
2653.text: And all the tent pins for the tabernacle and for the courtyard round about were of copper.

2654.label: Exodus 38:21
2654.text: The following are the things inventoried of the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, which was inventoried at the command of Moses, as the service of the Levites under the guidance of Ithʹa·mar the son of Aaron the priest.

2655.label: Exodus 38:22
2655.text: And Bezʹal·el the son of Uʹri the son of Hur of the tribe of Judah did all that Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2656.label: Exodus 38:23
2656.text: And with him was O·hoʹli·ab the son of A·hisʹa·mach of the tribe of Dan, a craftsman and embroiderer and weaver in the blue thread and the wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine linen.

2657.label: Exodus 38:24
2657.text: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the holy place came to the amount of the gold of the wave offering, twenty-nine talents and seven hundred and thirty shekels by the shekel of the holy place.

2658.label: Exodus 38:25
2658.text: And the silver of the ones registered of the assembly was a hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels by the shekel of the holy place.

2659.label: Exodus 38:26
2659.text: The half shekel for an individual was the half of a shekel by the shekel of the holy place, for every man who was passing over to those who were registered from twenty years of age and upward, amounting to six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.

2660.label: Exodus 38:27
2660.text: And a hundred talents of silver went into the casting of the socket pedestals of the holy place and the socket pedestals of the curtain. A hundred socket pedestals equaled a hundred talents, a talent to a socket pedestal.

2661.label: Exodus 38:28
2661.text: And out of the thousand seven hundred and seventy-five shekels he made pegs for the pillars and overlaid their tops and joined them together.

2662.label: Exodus 38:29
2662.text: And the copper of the wave offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

2663.label: Exodus 38:30
2663.text: And with this he proceeded to make the socket pedestals of the entrance of the tent of meeting and the copper altar and the copper grating that belonged to it, and all the utensils of the altar,

2664.label: Exodus 38:31
2664.text: and the socket pedestals of the courtyard round about, and the socket pedestals of the gate of the courtyard, and all the tent pins of the tabernacle and all the tent pins of the courtyard round about.

2665.label: Exodus 39:1
2665.text: And out of the blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material they made garments of knitted work for ministering in the holy place. So they made the holy garments that were for Aaron, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2666.label: Exodus 39:2
2666.text: Accordingly he made the ephʹod of gold, blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen.

2667.label: Exodus 39:3
2667.text: Then they beat plates of gold to thin sheets, and he cut out threads to work in among the blue thread and the wool dyed reddish purple and the coccus scarlet material and the fine linen, as the work of an embroiderer.

2668.label: Exodus 39:4
2668.text: They made shoulder pieces for it that were joined. It was joined at its two extremities.

2669.label: Exodus 39:5
2669.text: And the girdle, which was upon it for tying it close, was of the same material according to its workmanship, of gold, blue thread, and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2670.label: Exodus 39:6
2670.text: Then they made the onyx stones set with settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a seal according to the names of the sons of Israel.

2671.label: Exodus 39:7
2671.text: So he placed them upon the shoulder pieces of the ephʹod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2672.label: Exodus 39:8
2672.text: Then he made the breastpiece with the workmanship of an embroiderer, like the workmanship of the ephʹod, out of gold, blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material and fine twisted linen.

2673.label: Exodus 39:9
2673.text: It proved to be foursquare when doubled. They made the breastpiece, when doubled, a span of the hand in its length and a span in its width.

2674.label: Exodus 39:10
2674.text: Then they filled it with four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz and emerald was the first row.

2675.label: Exodus 39:11
2675.text: And the second row was turquoise, sapphire and jasper.

2676.label: Exodus 39:12
2676.text: And the third row was leshʹem stone, agate and amethyst.

2677.label: Exodus 39:13
2677.text: And the fourth row was chrysʹo·lite and onyx and jade. They were set with settings of gold in their fillings.

2678.label: Exodus 39:14
2678.text: And the stones were according to the names of the sons of Israel. They were twelve according to their names, with the engravings of a seal, each according to its name for the twelve tribes.

2679.label: Exodus 39:15
2679.text: And they proceeded to make upon the breastpiece wreathed chains, in ropework, of pure gold.

2680.label: Exodus 39:16
2680.text: Then they made two settings of gold and two rings of gold and put the two rings upon the two extremities of the breastpiece.

2681.label: Exodus 39:17
2681.text: After that they put the two ropes of gold through the two rings at the extremities of the breastpiece.

2682.label: Exodus 39:18
2682.text: And they put the two ends of the two ropes through the two settings. Then they put them upon the shoulder pieces of the ephʹod, at the forefront of it.

2683.label: Exodus 39:19
2683.text: Next they made two rings of gold and set them at the two extremities of the breastpiece upon its edge that is on the side toward the ephʹod inward.

2684.label: Exodus 39:20
2684.text: Then they made two rings of gold and put them upon the two shoulder pieces of the ephʹod from below, on its forefront, near its place of joining, above the girdle of the ephʹod.

2685.label: Exodus 39:21
2685.text: Finally they bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephʹod with a blue string, that it might continue above the girdle of the ephʹod and the breastpiece might not get displaced from on top the ephʹod, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2686.label: Exodus 39:22
2686.text: Then he made the sleeveless coat of the ephʹod, the workmanship of a loom worker, all of blue thread.

2687.label: Exodus 39:23
2687.text: And the opening of the sleeveless coat was in the middle of it, like the opening of a coat of mail. Its opening had a border round about that it might not be torn.

2688.label: Exodus 39:24
2688.text: Then they made upon the hem of the sleeveless coat pomegranates of blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material, twisted together.

2689.label: Exodus 39:25
2689.text: Further, they made bells of pure gold and put the bells in between the pomegranates upon the hem of the sleeveless coat round about, in between the pomegranates;

2690.label: Exodus 39:26
2690.text: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate upon the hem of the sleeveless coat round about, for ministering, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2691.label: Exodus 39:27
2691.text: Next they made the robes of fine linen, the workmanship of a loom worker, for Aaron and his sons,

2692.label: Exodus 39:28
2692.text: and the turban of fine linen and the ornamental headgears of fine linen and the linen drawers of fine twisted linen,

2693.label: Exodus 39:29
2693.text: and the sash of fine twisted linen and blue thread and wool dyed reddish purple and coccus scarlet material, the work of a weaver, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2694.label: Exodus 39:30
2694.text: Finally they made the shining plate, the holy sign of dedication, out of pure gold and inscribed upon it an inscription with the engravings of a seal: “Holiness belongs to Jehovah.”

2695.label: Exodus 39:31
2695.text: Then they put a string of blue thread to it in order to put it upon the turban up above, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2696.label: Exodus 39:32
2696.text: So the work for the tabernacle of the tent of meeting all came to its completion, in that the sons of Israel kept doing according to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses. They did just so.

2697.label: Exodus 39:33
2697.text: And they proceeded to bring the tabernacle to Moses, the tent and all its utensils, its hooks, its panel frames, its bars and its pillars and its socket pedestals,

2698.label: Exodus 39:34
2698.text: and its covering of ram skins dyed red and its covering of sealskins and the curtain of the screen,

2699.label: Exodus 39:35
2699.text: and the ark of the testimony and its poles and the cover,

2700.label: Exodus 39:36
2700.text: the table, all its utensils and the showbread,

2701.label: Exodus 39:37
2701.text: the lampstand of pure gold, its lamps, the row of lamps, and all its utensils and the oil of illumination,

2702.label: Exodus 39:38
2702.text: and the altar of gold and the anointing oil and the perfumed incense and the screen for the entrance of the tent,

2703.label: Exodus 39:39
2703.text: the altar of copper and the grating of copper that belonged to it, its poles and all its utensils, the basin and its stand,

2704.label: Exodus 39:40
2704.text: the hangings of the courtyard, its pillars and its socket pedestals and the screen for the gate of the courtyard, its tent cords and its tent pins and all the utensils for the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of meeting,

2705.label: Exodus 39:41
2705.text: the garments of knitted work for ministering in the sanctuary, the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments of his sons for acting as priests.

2706.label: Exodus 39:42
2706.text: According to all that Jehovah had commanded Moses, that was the way the sons of Israel did all the service.

2707.label: Exodus 39:43
2707.text: And Moses got to see all the work, and, look! they had done it just as Jehovah had commanded. That was the way they had done. Consequently Moses blessed them.

2708.label: Exodus 40:1
2708.text: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:

2709.label: Exodus 40:2
2709.text: “On the day of the first month, on the first of the month, you are to set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

2710.label: Exodus 40:3
2710.text: And you must place the ark of the testimony in it and shut off approach to the Ark with the curtain.

2711.label: Exodus 40:4
2711.text: And you must bring the table in and set its arrangement in order, and you must bring in the lampstand and light up its lamps.

2712.label: Exodus 40:5
2712.text: And you must put the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony and put the screen of the entrance for the tabernacle in place.

2713.label: Exodus 40:6
2713.text: “And you must put the altar of burnt offering before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting,

2714.label: Exodus 40:7
2714.text: and you must put the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it.

2715.label: Exodus 40:8
2715.text: And you must place the courtyard round about and put up the screen of the gate of the courtyard.

2716.label: Exodus 40:9
2716.text: And you must take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and you must sanctify it and all its utensils, and so it must become something holy.

2717.label: Exodus 40:10
2717.text: And you must anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils and sanctify the altar, and so it must become a most holy altar.

2718.label: Exodus 40:11
2718.text: And you must anoint the basin and its stand and sanctify it.

2719.label: Exodus 40:12
2719.text: “Then you must bring Aaron and his sons near to the entrance of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.

2720.label: Exodus 40:13
2720.text: And you must clothe Aaron with the holy garments and anoint him and sanctify him, and so he must act as priest to me.

2721.label: Exodus 40:14
2721.text: After that you will bring his sons near and you must clothe them with robes.

2722.label: Exodus 40:15
2722.text: And you must anoint them just as you anointed their father, and so they must act as priests to me, and their anointing must serve continually for them as a priesthood to time indefinite during their generations.”

2723.label: Exodus 40:16
2723.text: And Moses proceeded to do according to all that Jehovah had commanded him. He did just so.

2724.label: Exodus 40:17
2724.text: Accordingly it came about that in the first month, in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was set up.

2725.label: Exodus 40:18
2725.text: When Moses proceeded to set up the tabernacle, he went putting its socket pedestals down and placing its panel frames and putting its bars in and setting up its pillars.

2726.label: Exodus 40:19
2726.text: Then he spread out the tent over the tabernacle and placed the covering of the tent above upon it, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2727.label: Exodus 40:20
2727.text: After that he took the Testimony and put it into the Ark and placed the poles on the Ark and put the cover above upon the Ark.

2728.label: Exodus 40:21
2728.text: Then he brought the Ark into the tabernacle and put the curtain of the screen in place and shut off approach to the ark of the testimony, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2729.label: Exodus 40:22
2729.text: Next he put the table in the tent of meeting on the side of the tabernacle to the north outside the curtain,

2730.label: Exodus 40:23
2730.text: and he arranged the row of bread upon it before Jehovah, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2731.label: Exodus 40:24
2731.text: Then he placed the lampstand in the tent of meeting in front of the table, on the side of the tabernacle to the south.

2732.label: Exodus 40:25
2732.text: He then lit up the lamps before Jehovah, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2733.label: Exodus 40:26
2733.text: He next placed the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the curtain,

2734.label: Exodus 40:27
2734.text: that he might make perfumed incense smoke upon it, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2735.label: Exodus 40:28
2735.text: Finally he put the screen of the entrance of the tabernacle in place.

2736.label: Exodus 40:29
2736.text: And he placed the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, that he might offer up the burnt offering and the grain offering upon it, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2737.label: Exodus 40:30
2737.text: Then he placed the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing.

2738.label: Exodus 40:31
2738.text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet at it.

2739.label: Exodus 40:32
2739.text: When they went into the tent of meeting and when they went near to the altar they would wash, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

2740.label: Exodus 40:33
2740.text: Finally he set up the courtyard round about the tabernacle and the altar and put up the screen of the gate of the courtyard. So Moses finished the work.

2741.label: Exodus 40:34
2741.text: And the cloud began to cover the tent of meeting, and Jehovah’s glory filled the tabernacle.

2742.label: Exodus 40:35
2742.text: And Moses was not able to go into the tent of meeting, because the cloud resided over it and Jehovah’s glory filled the tabernacle.

2743.label: Exodus 40:36
2743.text: And when the cloud lifted itself up from over the tabernacle the sons of Israel would break camp during all their stages of journey.

2744.label: Exodus 40:37
2744.text: However, if the cloud did not lift itself up, then they would not break camp until the day when it lifted itself up.

2745.label: Exodus 40:38
2745.text: For Jehovah’s cloud was over the tabernacle by day, and a fire continued upon it by night in the sight of all the house of Israel during all their stages of journey.
